jobs.jobDescription:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

Dandy is seeking a Procurement Lead to help scale our growing Procurement organization. This role is responsible for ensuring uninterrupted supply of production materials through inventory planning, purchase order management, supplier coordination, and continuous process improvement.

The Procurement Lead serves as the operational owner for a portfolio of suppliers and materials while partnering closely with Materials Planning, Finance, Manufacturing, and Operations. In addition to executing day-to-day procurement activities, this individual will improve processes, document best practices, develop reporting, and mentor junior procurement team members.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving operational problems, building scalable processes, and driving measurable business impact.

What You'll Do

Procurement Operations

  • Manage the end-to-end purchasing process for assigned commodities and suppliers

  • Create, monitor, and expedite purchase orders in NetSuite

  • Manage supplier communication regarding lead times, order confirmations, shortages, and delivery issues

  • Resolve purchase order discrepancies, invoice issues, and receiving exceptions

  • Monitor open purchase orders and drive timely supplier follow-up

Inventory Planning

  • Review inventory health and demand signals to prevent stockouts and excess inventory

  • Execute purchasing decisions based on forecasts, reorder points, and business priorities

  • Partner with Materials Planning to balance inventory investment with service levels

  • Monitor supplier performance against lead time and delivery expectations

Supplier Management

  • Build strong working relationships with suppliers

  • Identify supply risks and escalate mitigation plans

  • Support supplier performance reviews and continuous improvement initiatives

  • Partner with suppliers to improve delivery performance and reduce operational issues

Process Improvement

  • Develop and maintain Procurement SOPs and documentation

  • Identify opportunities to automate or simplify procurement workflows

  • Create dashboards and reporting that improve operational visibility

  • Standardize best practices across the Procurement team

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Operations, Finance, AP, Logistics, and Planning teams

  • Communicate inventory risks, supplier constraints, and purchasing priorities

  • Support new product introductions and material transitions

  • Participate in cross-functional projects that improve supply chain performance

Leadership & Team Development

  • Mentor and train Procurement Agents and Buyers

  • Share subject matter expertise and establish best practices

  • Support onboarding of new team members

  • Serve as a resource for complex procurement questions and escalations

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of procurement, purchasing, supply chain, or inventory planning experience

  • Experience purchasing production materials in a manufacturing environment

  • Strong ERP experience (NetSuite preferred)

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills

  • Experience building reports and analyzing inventory data

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to prioritize multiple competing requests in a fast-paced environment

Preferred

  • Experience with demand planning or inventory planning

  • Experience writing SOPs and improving operational processes

  • Experience mentoring or leading team members

  • Knowledge of supplier performance metrics and procurement KPIs

Success in this Role

Within your first year, you will:

  • Maintain healthy inventory levels while minimizing stockout risk

  • Improve purchase order cycle times and supplier responsiveness

  • Create scalable procurement documentation and reporting

  • Drive measurable process improvements across Procurement

  • Become a trusted partner to Operations, Planning, and Finance

  • Help develop and elevate the capabilities of the Procurement team

Req ID: J-218

jobs.jobDescription:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About the Role:

The Dealer Development Manager will represent Upgrade Inc (Auto Finance Division) and promote our indirect lending programs. They will develop, maintain, and grow business partnerships between Upgrade Inc. and our dealership partners. The Dealer Development Manager is also responsible for staying up-to-date on local market conditions and industry trends. In this role, you will work with internal partners to find solutions that better serve our customers, and build long lasting relationships with key decision makers to drive growth and continuous improvement. This position requires residency in the greater Portland area.

What You’ll Do:

Dealer Relationship Management

  • Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing dealer partners
  • Act as a trusted advisor to dealership owners, GMs, and F&I managers
  • Conduct regular in-person dealership visits based on a structured drive schedule
  • Deliver consistent follow-up and service to ensure dealer satisfaction and loyalty

Dealer Acquisition & Activation

  • Identify, onboard, and activate new dealer partners
  • Drive dealer sign-ups and first deals (“activation”)
  • Re-engage inactive dealers (e.g., no deals in 90 days) and return them to production
  • Execute onboarding training to ensure dealers understand programs and systems

Production & Volume Growth

  • Achieve monthly funding and application volume goals
  • Increase contracts per active dealer and overall territory production
  • Focus on growing volume in Tier 3–5 segments while maintaining quality
  • Drive penetration targets (e.g., 3+ and 5+ deals per dealer per month)

Credit & Deal Structuring

  • Partner closely with underwriting/credit teams to structure deals effectively
  • Educate dealers on program guidelines, stips, and deal packaging
  • Improve pull-through by coaching dealers on submitting clean, fundable deals

Portfolio Performance & Quality

  • Monitor dealer portfolio performance (delinquency, charge-offs, profitability)
  • Manage dealer mix to align with company risk appetite and profitability goals
  • Shift focus toward preferred collateral and higher-performing dealers
  • Ensure adherence to compliance, credit policies, and documentation standards

Training & Dealer Development

  • Conduct ongoing product and process training with dealership staff
  • Educate dealers on value-added products
  • Provide market insights and best practices to improve dealer success
  • Position the company as a relationship-driven partner vs. transactional lender

Territory & Activity Management

  • Maintain a disciplined weekly drive schedule maximizing in-person dealer time
  • Track and manage activity through CRM (e.g., Salesforce)
  • Analyze territory performance and adjust strategy based on data
  • Participate in team calls, sales meetings, and performance reviews

What We Look For:

  • 2+ years of experience in indirect auto finance, auto sales, or related field
  • Strong understanding of credit tiers, loan structuring, and dealership operations
  • Proven ability to build relationships and drive sales growth
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills
  • Self-motivated with strong time management and territory planning skills
  • Ability to travel locally (significant field time required)

What We Offer You:

  • Competitive salary, uncapped commission and stock option plan
  • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Flexible PTO
  • Competitive 401(k)
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Paid parental leave
  • Health & wellness initiatives

jobs.jobDescription:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Senior Event Producer, AV & Keynote Production

Position Summary

As part of the Global Events team, this role is responsible for the strategic planning and execution of audiovisual production, executive keynote development, and agenda delivery across Kaseya's flagship customer conferences in North America, Europe, and APAC.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized project manager with 5+ years experience producing large-scale live events and executive keynote presentations. They are equally comfortable managing cross-functional stakeholders, overseeing complex audiovisual productions, and partnering with senior executives. They thrive in fast-paced environments, communicate proactively, anticipate challenges, and consistently deliver high-quality experiences for audiences of up to 5,000 attendees.

Key Responsibilities

Agenda & Content Project Management

  • Own the conference agenda framework and logistics across all content delivered at the event.
  • Lead recurring cross-functional planning meetings to track progress, manage dependencies, oversee session logistics, identify risks, and ensure all content remains on schedule.
  • Manage project timelines and production specifications for presentation decks, videos, demos, and technical assets across all conference programming.

AV & Production Management

  • Lead the strategy, planning, budgeting, and execution of all audiovisual production across Kaseya's global conferences, including keynotes, breakouts, trainings, ad-hoc meetings, expo halls, networking events, and off-site experiences.
  • Manage multimillion-dollar AV budgets and oversee vendor procurement and contract negotiations. Review equipment rentals, production schedules, and crew plans to ensure alignment with budget and technical requirements.
  • Lead technical planning for all event staging, LED displays, lighting, audio, video playback, rigging, power distribution, and internet requirements.
  • Develop comprehensive production documentation, including run-of-show schedules, technical cue sheets, production timelines and equipment requirements.

Executive Keynote Production

  • Project manage executive keynote development from concept through live delivery, coordinating timelines, show flow, and cross-functional collaboration across executive speakers, content, product, product marketing, and creative teams.
  • Drive accountability for keynote deliverables, proactively managing dependencies, keeping stakeholders aligned, and ensuring executive approval of messaging, presentations, and supporting content.
  • Lead onsite technical execution for all keynotes. This includes rehearsals, support and direction for show caller and stage manager, speaker transitions, troubleshooting, and live production decision-making, while proactively managing production risks and contingency plans.
  • Manage relationships and logistics with external keynote coaching partners, guest speakers, and customer speakers to ensure a seamless speaker preparation process.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in event production, with a focus on audiovisual and keynote production
  • Cross-functional project management
  • Executive stakeholder management
  • Audiovisual production management
  • Timeline and dependency management
  • Budget ownership and financial management
  • Vendor and contract management
  • Problem solving in fast-paced environments
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are seeking a people-focused HR Business Partner / Generalist to provide interim support while a member of our People team is out on leave. You’ll partner with the Chief People Officer and leaders across the business. The primary focus will be on employee relations, performance management, manager coaching, leave management, and ensuring consistent and thoughtful people practices. The ideal candidate brings strong business acumen, sound judgment, and deep knowledge of employment laws, particularly in California. This is a remote, part-time position (10 - 15 hours/week), anticipated to run from mid December through late April.

This is an opportunity for a seasoned HR professional who enjoys operating as a trusted advisor, building strong relationships, and helping a growing organization maintain a healthy, high-performing culture.

Responsibilities

Employee Relations & Performance Management

  • Provide hands-on guidance and support for complex employee relations matters, including investigations, conflict resolution, performance concerns, and employee escalations.
  • Coach managers through performance management situations, including feedback, positive performance plans, and appropriate documentation.
  • Partner with leaders to ensure consistent, fair, and legally sound approaches to employee matters.
  • Help foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and constructive feedback.

HR Operations & Compliance

  • Provide guidance on HR policies, practices, and employment-related matters.
  • Ensure HR practices align with applicable local, state, and federal employment laws and regulations, with particular emphasis on California employment law.
  • Partner with the People team on HR processes, documentation, and employee lifecycle matters as needed.

Manager Coaching & Development

  • Coach and develop managers on effective leadership practices, communication, performance management, and navigating a broad range of employee situations.
  • Build manager confidence and capability in handling people-related responsibilities.
  • Provide practical guidance to help leaders make thoughtful, informed, and consistent decisions.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive HR experience in roles such as HR Business Partner, HR Generalist, HR Manager, or similar.
  • 2+ years experience in managing all types of leaves (FLMA, ADA, STD, etc).
  • Strong understanding of employment laws and regulations at the local, state, and federal levels, including California employment law.
  • Significant hands-on experience managing employee relations matters and supporting performance management processes.
  • Proven ability to coach managers through sensitive employee situations.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect people strategies to broader business objectives.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters with professionalism.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment with the ability to balance strategic priorities with hands-on execution.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and the ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the broader People team.

Engagement Details

  • Time Commitment: Approximately 10 - 15 hours per week based on business needs
  • Anticipated Timeframe: Mid December - Late April
  • Compensation: $75 - $100/hour
  • Reporting To: Chief People Officer
  • Location: Remote

jobs.jobDescription:
Are you ready to own something big? Automox is turning IT admins into IT heroes by replacing traditional tools with our award winning cloud-native endpoint management platform. Our product works autonomously and so do our teams. We value a ‘one team’ mentality where everyone’s unique skills contribute to an environment that encourages collaboration and ownership. At Automox you’re enabled to do your best work, grow your career, and have an impact that will be noticeable. WE ARE A_TOMOX… all that’s missing is U!

Our Customer Experience team doesn’t wait for the renewal conversation to prove value. We’re searching for a strategic, action-oriented Director of Customer Adoption & Digital Success who’s excited to build the programs that get every Automox customer to realize value at scale. You’ll own the lifecycle automation, customer education, in-product guidance and 1:many engagements that reach every customer, from small businesses to our largest enterprise accounts.

This is a strategic builder role reporting to the VP of Customer Experience. You’ll arrive with a point of view, experiment quickly, and improve with data. You’ll work closely with Account Management, Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, Product and Marketing to turn adoption into stronger retention.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN & DRIVE

  • Define the adoption model for each customer segment, including what is automated, what is 1:many, and where human touch matters most.
  • Build and run lifecycle journeys at scale for onboarding, adoption milestones and pre-renewal sentiment using data-driven triggers for risk, low deployment and expansion.
  • Partner with Ops to enhance our customer success platform, health scoring, journey orchestration and dashboards.
  • Partner with Marketing to develop and execute customer campaigns that drive product adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion opportunities.
  • Lead the strategy for Automox University (our on-demand training platform for users), customer workshops and in-product guidance, partnering with Product and Growth to improve education directly in the product.
  • Lead the strategy for Automox’s knowledge management and AI-powered self-service support experience called Patch AI.
  • Own roadmap planning of customer engagements (webinars, office hours, campaigns and communication).
  • Lead the pooled digital customer success motion for our digital customer segment.
  • Run the NPS program, routing voice of the customer themes to executive leadership.
  • Measure the effectiveness of customer engagement initiatives, continuously optimizing campaigns to improve adoption, customer health, and retention.
  • Lead and grow a team covering customer enablement, education and digital customer success.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

  • 8+ years in customer success, digital success or customer marketing at a B2B SaaS company, including 3+ years leading teams.
  • A track record of building a scaled or digital customer success program from an early stage, not only running an existing one.
  • Hands-on experience with a customer success platform (Gainsight, ChurnZero, Planhat, Vitally or similar) and journey automation.
  • Strong data skills: health scores, cohort analysis, and tying programs to gross and net dollar retention.
  • Experience partnering with Product on onboarding, in-app guidance or customer education.
  • Clear writing and the ability to turn a strategy into a plan with owners, dates and metrics.
  • A bias to action, driving impactful work forward quickly.
  • The ability to build strong partnerships with Sales, Marketing and Product.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with IT, security or infrastructure software sold to technical buyers.
  • Background with in-product guidance tools such as Chameleon, Pendo or Appcues, and customer education platforms.
  • Experience applying AI to customer engagement or self-service support.
  • A background in IT operations, endpoint management or security, such as patching and vulnerability response.

The range listed is the on target earning (OTE) potential. OTE is a mix of base pay and variable pay earned based on meeting sale's goals. In addition to OTE our compensation package includes equity and variety of great benefits. LOCATION

ABOUT AUTOMOX

Automox is the cloud-native IT operations platform for modern organizations. Our award-winning answer to modern IT operations and best-in-class results earned Automox four straight quarters of record growth. We are now trusted by more than 2,500 leading companies and MSPs worldwide, including NASA, Yale, Xerox, Allbirds, and Unicef. It makes it easy to keep every endpoint automatically configured, patched, and secured – anywhere in the world. The future of IT Operations is cloud-native – and right now. Will you join us?

EMPLOYMENT AT AUTOMOX

TOTAL REWARDS: Thrive with Us

👨‍👧‍👦 $10k Adoption Benefit

🤰🏽Comprehensive Family Planning Covered on Meritian Medical Plan

We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any legally protected status.

jobs.jobDescription:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you'll do at Jamf:

The Financial Analyst will provide financial decision support to key leadership team members by providing in-depth analyses of key performance indicators, by tracking and benchmarking financial trends, and by significantly contributing to the forecasting, budgeting, and monthly close processes.

What you can expect to do in this role:

  • Deliver timely financial insights and analysis to support executive decision-making and strategy.
  • Lead budgeting and forecasting activities for assigned business areas, ensuring accurate application of accounting policies (if applicable) and best practices.
  • Analyze monthly results, prepare variance explanations, and communicate findings to business partners.
  • Aggregate, analyze, and present data to support operational and strategic decisions.
  • Build and maintain data, reports, and key metrics within planning and reporting tools.
  • Create financial modeling, scenario planning, and analysis for key initiatives.
  • Produce non-standard management reports and support ad hoc analyses.
  • Prepare information used for corporate reporting.
  • Foster strong partnerships across teams to ensure aligned financial results and insights.
  • Demonstrate and uphold the organization’s core values while contributing to a positive, inclusive workplace.
  • Identity opportunities to apply AI tools for automating processes and improving accuracy

What we are looking for:

  • Minimum of 2 years financial planning & analysis experience (Required)
  • Experience in the software industry (Preferred)
  • Experience using forecasting, reporting, & accounting software (Preferred)
  • Experience with AI tools (Preferred)
  • Ability and desire to learn with a positive attitude
  • Focus on accuracy and efficiency
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain finance concepts to non-financial leaders
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

  • 4 Year / Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or equivalent (Required)
  • A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

How we help you reach your best potential:

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Mental Well-being
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
  • Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
  • Named a 2024 Best Technology Company to Work For by U.S. News
  • We know that big ideas can come from anyone, so we empower everyone to make an impact. Our 90% employee retention rate agrees!
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.
  • Our volunteer time off allows employees to support and give back to our communities.
  • We encourage you to simply be you. We constantly seek and value different perspectives to ensure Jamf is a place where everyone feels comfortable and can be successful.

Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

#LIRemote

The national pay transparency range below represents all U.S. locations and accounts for geographic differences in pay, resulting in a broader range.

National Pay Transparency Range

$67,000—$100,000 USD

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees. If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. To request accommodations please email us at recruiting@jamf.com

jobs.jobDescription:
Tines is the complete environment for enterprise AI, trusted by organizations like Reddit, SAP, Mars, Fin, and Headspace. Tines gives all teams a safe, scalable way to turn their expertise into software, whatever their technical background.

Since its founding in 2018, Tines has enabled over 600 enterprise customers to run their most important work, where reliability and security aren't optional. From IT and business operations to security and beyond, Tines empowers teams to build apps, agents and automations to solve complex problems and bring their ideas to life.

Founded by Eoin Hinchy and Thomas Kinsella and co-headquartered in Dublin and Boston, Tines is truly agnostic and helps organizations bring their entire technology stack – any model, any tool, any system, any infrastructure – together.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

About The Role

We're looking for an exceptional sales leader to build and scale our Commercial business and sales team. You'll be instrumental in driving Tines's next phase of growth by developing and executing winning go-to-market strategies.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build and lead a team of high-caliber sales professionals who share our vision of revolutionizing automation
  • Create and implement scalable processes that enable consistent success across the sales organization
  • Drive strategic pipeline growth through innovative approaches to field sales, marketing collaborations, and partnership development
  • Design and execute regional account strategies that emphasize collaborative selling and maximize market penetration
  • Work closely with our Sales Engineering team to deliver compelling product demonstrations and establish a robust proof-of-concept program
  • Foster deep relationships with customers focused on driving concrete value, resulting in strong renewals, expansions, and advocacy
  • Own revenue forecasting through methodical deal analysis and disciplined processes
  • Expand our partner ecosystem through strategic relationship building and program development

What You Bring With You

  • 10+ years of SaaS/technology sales experience including 3+ years of direct leadership experience
  • Proven track record of exceeding quotas and driving results in enterprise software sales, particularly with transformational technology
  • Experience building and leading high-performing sales teams that consistently create new opportunities and acquire new customers
  • A passion for winning and personal accountability for achieving ambitious goals
  • Demonstrated success in navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in emerging technology markets
  • History of closing commercial deals
  • Strong executive presence and ability to build lasting relationships at all levels
  • Exceptional ability to translate technical capabilities into compelling business value
  • Deep understanding of modern enterprise sales methodologies (MEDDIC, Challenger Sale, etc.)
  • Outstanding communication skills and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Ability to travel up to 30% of the time

Location: San Francisco Bay Area (Remote)

Compensation: $340-350k OTE + Equity

#LI-SW1 #LI-Remote

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

jobs.jobDescription:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Sales Engineer to continue building an industry-defining sales team. This role will work closely with Account Executives to tailor Dandy’s value to each practice we talk to through demonstrations of our product, answering technical questions, and providing in-depth knowledge of Dandy’s offering and the overall Dental industry. A successful Sales Engineer will be an expert on all things regarding analog and digital materials and processes in the laboratory and the operatory. They should also take the time to learn industry trends and Dandy’s innovations in order to be a resource for our customers and prospects. A Sales Engineer should be excited to work with customers, answer questions, and help them get to the "aha!" moment when they see Dandy’s value.

What You’ll Do

  • Become an expert on Dandy’s product offerings, workflows, and the dental industry

  • Be the go-to person for highly complex questions from prospective practices we are selling to

  • Work hand in hand with Enablement to help educate Dandy sellers on current and future offerings

  • Continue to challenge yourself and those around you to be an ambassador

  • Have an understanding of the Dandy sale process and supporting methodologies

  • Help Account Executives run demonstrations of the product for prospective practices

  • Work with Account Executives to deliver a tailored sales experience based on the pain & priorities of each practice.

  • Be a champion not only for Dandy, but also for the doctors that you interact with

  • Work cross-functionally with our internal teams to learn the newest Dandy offerings and how Dentists can transform their practice

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience as a Dental Technician (CDT preferred) in customer-facing roles within the dental lab space - sales experience preferred

  • Desire to learn all the nuances of Dandy’s digital workflows and how they relate to the analog workflows

  • Desire to teach our customers to think differently about their practice

  • Quick learner who can adapt to a high-paced rate of change

  • Ability to make complex laboratory concepts simple for customers to understand

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills

  • BA/BS degree is preferred

    • Dental Lab Degrees (Associate of Applied Science) strongly preferred

For full-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

Dandy also fully complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals. jobs.jobDescription:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About the Role:

The Dealer Development Manager will represent Upgrade Inc (Auto Finance Division) and promote our indirect lending programs. They will develop, maintain, and grow business partnerships between Upgrade Inc. and our dealership partners. The Dealer Development Manager is also responsible for staying up-to-date on local market conditions and industry trends. In this role, you will work with internal partners to find solutions that better serve our customers, and build long lasting relationships with key decision makers to drive growth and continuous improvement. This position requires residency in the greater Las Vegas area.

What You’ll Do:

Dealer Relationship Management

  • Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing dealer partners
  • Act as a trusted advisor to dealership owners, GMs, and F&I managers
  • Conduct regular in-person dealership visits based on a structured drive schedule
  • Deliver consistent follow-up and service to ensure dealer satisfaction and loyalty

Dealer Acquisition & Activation

  • Identify, onboard, and activate new dealer partners
  • Drive dealer sign-ups and first deals (“activation”)
  • Re-engage inactive dealers (e.g., no deals in 90 days) and return them to production
  • Execute onboarding training to ensure dealers understand programs and systems

Production & Volume Growth

  • Achieve monthly funding and application volume goals
  • Increase contracts per active dealer and overall territory production
  • Focus on growing volume in Tier 3–5 segments while maintaining quality
  • Drive penetration targets (e.g., 3+ and 5+ deals per dealer per month)

Credit & Deal Structuring

  • Partner closely with underwriting/credit teams to structure deals effectively
  • Educate dealers on program guidelines, stips, and deal packaging
  • Improve pull-through by coaching dealers on submitting clean, fundable deals

Portfolio Performance & Quality

  • Monitor dealer portfolio performance (delinquency, charge-offs, profitability)
  • Manage dealer mix to align with company risk appetite and profitability goals
  • Shift focus toward preferred collateral and higher-performing dealers
  • Ensure adherence to compliance, credit policies, and documentation standards

Training & Dealer Development

  • Conduct ongoing product and process training with dealership staff
  • Educate dealers on value-added products
  • Provide market insights and best practices to improve dealer success
  • Position the company as a relationship-driven partner vs. transactional lender

Territory & Activity Management

  • Maintain a disciplined weekly drive schedule maximizing in-person dealer time
  • Track and manage activity through CRM (e.g., Salesforce)
  • Analyze territory performance and adjust strategy based on data
  • Participate in team calls, sales meetings, and performance reviews

What We Look For:

  • 2+ years of experience in indirect auto finance, auto sales, or related field
  • Strong understanding of credit tiers, loan structuring, and dealership operations
  • Proven ability to build relationships and drive sales growth
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills
  • Self-motivated with strong time management and territory planning skills
  • Ability to travel locally (significant field time required)

What We Offer You:

  • Competitive salary, uncapped commission and stock option plan
  • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Flexible PTO
  • Competitive 401(k)
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Paid parental leave
  • Health & wellness initiatives

#LI-Hybrid

For California residents: Upgrade's California Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy describes our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of the personal information of job applicants.

Environmental & Working Conditions

Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.

Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.

The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.

Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position.

Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings.

Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

The Role

We are looking for a strategy professional to join Kaseya's Corporate Strategy team. This is a high visibility, high impact role that sits at the intersection of data-driven analysis and executive-level decision making. You will work closely with senior leadership to develop strategic recommendations, lead analytical workstreams, and drive special initiatives across the business.

The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in financial modeling and quantitative analysis — honed through investment banking, management consulting, or corporate finance — combined with intellectual curiosity, strong communication skills, and a genuine interest in how AI tools are reshaping the way strategy work gets done.

This role offers significant breadth: one week you may be building a pricing model to evaluate a go-to-market decision; the next, you may be running a cross-functional working session or preparing materials for a board-level strategic review.

What You'll Do

  • Drive strategic analysis and recommendations — own end-to-end analytical workstreams including market sizing, competitive benchmarking, pricing strategy, business case development, and performance analysis
  • Build financial models to assess and pressure test project feasibility: create bespoke, “on the fly” analyses (e.g., with Excel) to bring quantitative rigor to a wide range of business problems
  • Leverage data to tell compelling stories — pull and manipulate data, synthesize findings, and translate complex analyses into clear, executive-ready narratives and presentations
  • Run meetings and cross-functional processes — facilitate working sessions, manage project timelines, and keep senior stakeholders aligned across fast-moving initiatives projects as they arise
  • Experiment with and champion AI tools — actively explore how AI can improve the quality, speed, and scale of strategy work, and share best practices with the team

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in investment banking, management consulting, corporate finance, or a similar analytically rigorous environment
  • Proven ability to own complex analytical projects independently, from scoping through delivery

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills — comfortable building models from scratch
  • SQL proficiency (or strong willingness to develop it) — ability to query databases, join datasets, and extract insights without relying on data engineering support
  • Familiarity with AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar) and a genuine interest in staying ahead of how these tools are evolving

Soft Skills

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication — able to distill ambiguous, complex problems into clear frameworks and persuasive recommendations
  • Strong executive presence and comfort running meetings with senior stakeholders
  • Highly organized and structured thinker; able to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

Why This Role

  • Direct exposure to C-suite and senior leadership on high-stakes decisions
  • Broad remit across Kaseya's full business — pricing, competitive strategy, M&A, product strategy, and more
  • A team that moves fast, thinks rigorously, and has real influence on company direction

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.jobDescription:
Help the world move AI.

At Kong, we're building the connectivity layer that brings AI, APIs, and applications together. Our work helps organizations innovate faster, more securely, and more efficiently.

We're looking for people who think boldly, lead with purpose, and want to make an impact. If you're ready to take on meaningful challenges, do work that matters, and help build what comes next for technology, we'd love to meet you.

About the Role:

Every company is racing to connect AI agents and LLMs to its APIs, data, and systems, securely and at scale. Kong sits at the intersection of API management and AI connectivity, and as a Staff Solutions Engineer you’ll be the person who makes that story real for customers. You won’t just be selling a platform. You’ll be a trusted technical advisor, partnering with Account Executives to lead the technical sale with enterprise and strategic customers as they architect secure, scalable API ecosystems and move into the agentic AI era.

What You’ll Do:

  • Help customers understand the value of Kong’s API and AI connectivity platform, including AI Gateway, API Gateway, MCP, event streaming, and integration.

  • Shape how organizations connect AI agents and LLMs to their APIs, data, and business systems, with the right security, governance, cost control, and observability.

  • Run discovery conversations and map customer requirements to Kong solutions, through architecture design, demos, and proofs of concept, and into production.

  • Lead POCs and technical evaluations from start to finish, owning technical validation and stakeholder alignment.

  • Lead API management and AI governance evaluations, including scoping API and AI use cases, LLM traffic management, and governance requirements.

  • Deliver demos of Kong’s API and AI governance and agentic connectivity capabilities, including MCP governance, semantic caching, prompt guardrails, and shadow AI detection.

  • Run API- and AI-focused Technical Feasibility Workshops (TFWs) to validate Kong’s fit for modern and agentic architectures.

  • Own the technical strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals, from qualification through close.

  • Use AI to create impactful messaging, demos, and solutions tailored to each customer’s business.

  • Ensure customer success across your assigned accounts, onboarding new customers and identifying growth opportunities in existing ones.

  • Mentor and coach junior SEs on technical skills, discovery methods, and deal strategy.

  • Collaborate with Support, Product, and Engineering to advocate for customer needs, and synthesize customer feedback and market signals into actionable roadmap input.

  • Create technical documentation for DevOps, implementation, and services engagements.

  • Drive thought leadership through technical blogs, webinars, and speaking at industry events and conferences such as AWS re:Invent, Google Next, and API & AI Summit.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years of software engineering and/or solutions engineering experience at a SaaS, open source, or enterprise software company.

  • A proven track record owning complex, enterprise-level deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders.

  • Experience mentoring or coaching other SEs or technical team members.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or OpenAI Codex (or equivalent).

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms.

  • Experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and API security patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS).

  • Working knowledge of AI/LLM architectures, including model routing, rate limiting, semantic caching, and prompt governance.

  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic AI patterns.

  • A solid understanding of cloud computing trends and open source business models.

  • Confidence presenting to and leading discussions with C-level and Director-level executives, product managers, architects, and engineers. You’re a strong listener who can tell the business story and go deep on the technology.

  • Enthusiasm for a high-profile, fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with API gateways, API integration, iPaaS, ETL, or microservices architectures.

  • Experience building with LLMs, agent frameworks, RAG, or MCP servers, or working with AI platforms and model providers.

  • Experience with event streaming, such as Kafka.

  • Familiarity with the major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

#LI-MP1

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

jobs.jobDescription:
DTC GROWTH STRATEGIST

A DTC Growth Strategist at CTC drives profitable growth for clients by translating raw financial data into precise marketing maneuvers. You will guide clients and teammates with clear financial models, diagnostic reviews, and actionable recommendations, ensuring every marketing dollar is understood through the lens of profit.

When results deviate from plan, you’ll take ownership in diagnosing the issue, adjusting forecasts, and optimizing within the meta account in order to restore profitable growth. Above all, you are the financial steward of your accounts—trusted to bring clarity, accuracy, and solutions that align business goals with sustainable outcomes.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

YOU SET THE STANDARD

  • You seek to define “best in class” across both growth strategy and media buying.
  • You arrive prepared with forecasts, insights, and clear next steps.
  • You approach challenge and failure with curiosity and resilience.
  • Your word is trustworthy — people know that if you are involved, it will get done.
  • Your word is trustworthy; you do what you say you will

YOU ARE DRIVEN TO INCREASE VALUE

  • You exist to turn marketing strategies into financial outcomes.
  • You’re excited by the complexities of a business and love identifying growth solutions.
  • You thrive at translating platform execution into contribution margin and growth targets.
  • You clearly articulate complex concepts in ways that clients and teammates can understand.
  • You are in the habit of documenting, reporting, and forecasting your work.

YOU CREATE AN ENVIRONMENT OF EXCELLENCE

  • You inspire others with your expertise and strategic thinking.
  • You proactively share insights with your team and clients.
  • You embody humility (willing to do the work), ambition (vision for the future), and empathy (understanding what drives others).
  • You contribute learnings back into CTC’s systems and playbooks.
  • You balance strategy, execution, and communication to help others thrive.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

STRATEGY & FORECASTING

  • Build and maintain growth forecasts in Statlas.
  • Align forecasts with marketing calendars, launches, and contribution margin goals.
  • Translate forecasts into daily/weekly pacing to ensure spend and performance remain within targets.

MEDIA EXECUTION

  • Build, manage, and optimize campaigns across Meta, wile overseeing the management of Google, and YouTube (with expansion to TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat).
  • Lead creative diversification and media testing to profitably scale accounts.
  • Design and interpret incrementality tests (geo holdouts, conversion lift) and integrate results into iROAS modeling.
  • Troubleshoot campaigns quickly and pivot strategies when needed.

CLIENT COMMUNICATION & STORYTELLING

  • Serve as the primary growth partner for your accounts.
  • Communicate forecasts, results, and recommendations with clarity and confidence.
  • Lead weekly updates, monthly reviews, and quarterly planning sessions.

COLLABORATION & CONTRIBUTION

  • Contribute your learnings back into CTC’s shared processes and tools.
  • Act as a subject matter expert, helping advance CTC’s Growth Engineer framework.

Note: Pixel and feed health are managed by a separate floating ops resource. This role is focused on strategy, execution, and client outcomes.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Holding a book of business above agreed upon revenue targets
  • Retaining clients while guiding clients toward profitable growth
  • Consistently deliver forecasts within ±5% accuracy.
  • Grow Contribution Margin quarter over quarter
  • Grow media spend quarter over quarter at or above iROAS thresholds.
  • Run and apply incrementality tests that shape client investment decisions.
  • Demonstrate clear link between execution and contribution margin outcomes.
  • Earn client trust through clear communication, preparedness, and results.
  • Embody CTC’s values — Set the Standard, Driven to Increase Value, Create an Environment of Excellence.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE

  • 4–6 years in eCommerce growth marketing with direct account ownership.
  • Proven ability to manage $100K+/month in paid media spend.
  • Hands-on expertise in Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, YouTube; familiarity with TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat.
  • Experience designing and interpreting incrementality tests.
  • Strong analytical skills with fluency in contribution margin, iROAS, and financial modeling.
  • High EQ and communication skills: trusted advisor, clear storyteller, resilient problem solver.
  • Curiosity and adaptability: thrive in ambiguity, learn fast, and share knowledge generously.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

SALARY RANGE

  • $120K - $150K base salary, annually
    • This is prior to any benefits (see the “ABOUT US” Section for additional details
  • Bonus Structure | $30K-$50K bonus tiers

ABOUT US

At CTC, we are fixated on building the next generation of legendary brands and the people who will lead them.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing this mission, we organize all of our decisions — from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money — in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone. They're challenging.

In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

For those who resonate with the following values, CTC has proven itself to be a remarkable place to grow and thrive.

  1. We Set the Standard
  2. We Are Driven To Increase Value
  3. We Create an Environment of Excellence

We’ll come alongside you and care for you in your pursuits by offering full-time permanent CTC employees:

  • 401K | program with a 3% company match (post 90 days employment) to bring out the investor inside you
  • TIME OFF | When you’re at CTC, you’re firing on all cylinders. To make that possible, we offer a Flexible Time Off policy where you will coordinate with supervisor to take time away from the office for rest, travel, and variety of others things that are important to you!
  • MEDICAL | Full health, dental, and vision benefits that fit your lifestyle and goals
  • WELLNESS | A wellness reimbursement program that inspires 360 degrees of health: mentally, physically, and spiritually

CTC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We Embrace I.D.E.A. and are committed to fostering a culture of performance and inclusivity.

jobs.jobDescription:
Regional Vice President, Biddable

Location: Remote, United States

About Doximity

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Our Pharma sales team is a variety of individuals with diverse backgrounds, all committed to our goal of helping our clients bring their important messaging to the healthcare professionals on our platform. We are launching a biddable platform in January, 2027 and will have a new go-to-market team to work closely with our sales teams and clients. We look for individuals who face challenges head on and are highly motivated to exceed sales goals. Presentation, communication, and closing skills are essential to be successful in this role.

As a Regional Vice President:

  • Develop expertise and sell biddable ad products
  • Support our clients by developing strategies that help brand product teams and marketing agencies make informed decisions through a consultative sales approach
  • Make data informed decisions through forecasting and business analytical skills to identify opportunities and reach goals
  • Build relationships and trust with agency and brand decision-makers
  • Develop and lead proposals and opportunities for client sales pitches
  • Collaborate with teams to ensure performance metric goals are achieved or exceeded

Location: This role is Remote, in the United States and will require travel to client meetings.

What We're Looking For

We're excited to meet candidates who have many of the following qualifications:

  • Programmatic and HCP healthcare sales experience (required). You have sold programmatic or biddable media to pharma brands and health agencies, and you know how HCP audiences are targeted and measured.
  • Auction-savvy. You can explain bids, budgets, pacing, and cost per engagement to a brand team, and you can coach a client from fixed guarantees toward performance-based buying.
  • Platform seller. You have sold a self-serve or managed-service ad platform (DSP, search, or retail media) and you know how to drive adoption, not just close an insertion order.
  • Embedded in the planning cycle. You have senior relationships with pharma manufacturers and health agencies, and you win early, when budgets are set, not just when RFPs go out.
  • Data literacy. Functional understanding of business analytics to maximize opportunities and prioritize goals.
  • Launch builder. You're energized by taking a new product to market, and you turn client feedback into input for pricing, packaging, and the product roadmap.
  • Goal-motivated. You thrive in a team that embraces accountability through individual sales quotas.

Compensation

The anticipated total compensation for this role is $192,500 - $313,833, depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

Our total compensation package may include:

  • Base salary
  • Equity (where applicable)
  • Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)

Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Flexible paid time off and company holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Professional development and learning opportunities
  • Wellness and mental health resources
  • Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

  • Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.
  • Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.
  • Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.
  • Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.
  • Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.

Our Hiring Process & AI Tools

Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

Kaseya is seeking a Senior Director, GTM Data Analytics to lead and scale the analytics capabilities that drive go-to-market performance and revenue growth. This strategic leadership role will define the vision, strategy, and operating model for GTM analytics, transforming complex data into actionable insights that inform executive decision-making, improve forecasting, and increase sales productivity.

The Senior Director will establish a trusted, integrated analytics framework across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Finance, ensuring leaders have consistent visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, rep-level performance, and key revenue drivers. This leader will oversee the development of scalable data products, KPI governance, automated reporting, and predictive analytics capabilities, including AI-enabled insights that improve business outcomes.

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for an analytics executive who can combine strategic vision, technical expertise, commercial acumen, and organizational leadership to build a world-class GTM analytics function. The successful candidate will partner closely with executive leadership to translate business priorities into analytical strategies that accelerate decision-making, improve accountability, and support Kaseya’s continued growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Data & Analytics Strategy: Define and execute a multi-year GTM analytics strategy aligned with business priorities and revenue objectives. Establish the operating model, delivery standards, and roadmap for analytical products, ensuring investments are prioritized based on business impact and measurable outcomes.
  • Executive Reporting & Decision Support: Own executive-level GTM performance reporting, scorecards, and analytics used to evaluate pipeline health, bookings, revenue, sales productivity, retention, and expansion. Translate complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations for executive leadership and board discussions.
  • KPI Development & Data Governance: Establish and maintain consistent, trusted definitions for GTM metrics, including pipeline, bookings, win rates, sales cycles, quota attainment, and rep productivity. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Finance to align metric definitions, ownership, data quality, and reporting standards.
  • Forecasting & Predictive Analytics: Lead the development and continuous improvement of pipeline, bookings, and revenue forecasting capabilities. Leverage historical trends, leading indicators, and predictive modeling to improve forecast accuracy, identify performance risks, and inform territory planning, capacity decisions, quotas, and resource allocation.
  • Data Integration & Automation: Partner with Data Engineering, IT, and Sales Operations to integrate CRM, marketing automation, customer success, product usage, billing, and financial data into a unified GTM analytics ecosystem. Drive automation of recurring reporting and develop scalable data models, dashboards, and analytical products using shared enterprise platforms.
  • AI-Enabled Insights & Innovation: Identify and implement opportunities to apply artificial intelligence, machine learning, and predictive analytics to GTM performance, including opportunity scoring, churn and expansion risk, forecast automation, and automated insight generation.
  • Executive Partnership & Business Adoption: Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior GTM and functional leaders. Collaborate with stakeholders to define business questions, identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and ensure analytical insights translate into decisions and measurable action. Drive adoption through effective communication, training, documentation, and integration into business operating routines.
  • Organizational Leadership & Development: Build and lead a scalable, multi-layer analytics organization, including managers and senior individual contributors. Establish organizational structures, career paths, and operating practices that support growth while developing future leaders and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and measurable business impact.
  • Budget & Resource Management: Own the GTM analytics budget, evaluate investments in talent and technology, and develop business cases that demonstrate the value of analytics initiatives. Prioritize resources and tooling to maximize efficiency, scalability, and business outcomes.
  • Continuous Improvement & Scalability: Establish standards for analytical solution development, testing, deployment, adoption, and ongoing improvement. Reduce manual reporting efforts, improve data reliability, and build reusable analytics capabilities that scale with business growth.
  • Cross-Functional Data Strategy: Partner with enterprise data and technology teams to influence platform priorities, integration strategies, and vendor decisions affecting GTM analytics. Support the integration of data and reporting from acquired businesses into Kaseya’s GTM analytics environment.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data strategy, reporting, or forecasting, including leadership of analytics functions supporting go-to-market organizations within SaaS or technology businesses.
  • Deep expertise in GTM and revenue analytics, including pipeline management, forecasting, sales performance, rep-level productivity, and revenue-driving metrics.
  • 5+ years of experience leading analytics or business intelligence teams, including managing managers and leading multiple teams or functions.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing an analytics strategy and building, scaling, or transforming an analytics organization.
  • Proven experience owning executive-level GTM reporting, KPI frameworks, forecasting, and decision-support capabilities within a complex organization.
  • Experience managing an analytics budget, evaluating technology investments, and prioritizing resources based on business impact.
  • Strong technical proficiency with Salesforce, Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform, and modern business intelligence and reporting tools.
  • Experience integrating multiple data sources, developing scalable reporting solutions, and implementing data governance practices that improve data quality, consistency, and automation.
  • Experience applying predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-enabled capabilities to business data to improve forecasting, performance insights, or decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence C-suite executives and senior business leaders, communicate complex analytical findings clearly, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Strong organizational leadership, strategic thinking, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in high-growth SaaS, enterprise software, IT management, cybersecurity, or a related technology environment.
  • Experience with Power BI or comparable business intelligence tools, semantic modeling, and enterprise BI governance.
  • Background in revenue analytics, Sales Operations, territory and capacity planning, or enterprise performance management.
  • Experience deploying predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-enabled solutions in production environments, including opportunity scoring, churn prediction, or forecast automation.
  • Experience integrating data, systems, and reporting capabilities following acquisitions, particularly within private-equity-backed or high-growth organizations.
  • Experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple regions.
  • Demonstrated success building scalable analytics capabilities that improve operational efficiency, sales productivity, and revenue performance.

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
