jobs.jobDescription:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Role:

We’re hiring a design leader to own the experience of AlphaSense’s most important frontier: the AI-native, agentic product our customers use to build on proprietary financial data.

AlphaSense is shifting from a research library into an end-to-end workflow platform: a "super analyst" with agentic, computer-use capabilities that lets analysts go from question to discovery to synthesis to finished work product (dashboards, decks, models, generated outputs) without leaving the platform. It’s an enormous opportunity, and today the experience is fragmented: years of incremental features, two search paradigms that don’t yet converge, no self-service onboarding, and a wide spectrum of AI fluency across our users.

You will own the design vision for the AI experience and lead a small team to ship it. You’ll set a clear point of view on where the UX is going, collaborate with Product and Engineering while constructively challenging decisions to raise the bar, and turn an ambiguous, cross-team problem space into a coherent, high-quality, trustworthy product.

This is a player-coach role: like all of our directors, you’ll lead a small team of senior designers while staying hands-on with the craft. We’re open to hiring at Director or Senior Director, depending on scope and experience, with a preference for candidates located in NYC, in a similar time zone, or able to travel.

Why this role matters

At AlphaSense, design is a core driver of how we win. As we build an AI-native platform, the quality of our user experience will define how effectively customers can navigate complexity, build conviction, and make high-stakes financial decisions with confidence.

In this role, you will set that standard through the AI experience you shape, the team you grow, and the craft bar you hold across the product.

What You’ll Do:

  • Set the UX direction for the core AI / agentic experience: a clear, opinionated vision for how analysts work with AI on high-stakes financial decisions, and a sequenced path from today’s product to that north star.
  • Lead through influence and craft: partner with an SVP of Product and multiple PMs (across NY and the UK), advocating for the best experience while working through business goals, timelines, and technical constraints to decide the real first step.
  • Solve the hard, data-dense UX problems: malleable UI with sensible defaults for hedge funds and banks (without overwhelming them), taming information overload, trust and transparency in AI-mediated workflows (citations, confidence, control, reversibility), and cohesion across surfaces.
  • Stay hands-on: prototype in code and with real data, contribute directly to the highest-leverage surfaces, and set the craft bar by doing the work, not just reviewing it.
  • Raise the bar for AI-native design: define how AI shows up as a first-party capability across the product, not just in one agentic pane.
  • Help evolve our foundations: contribute to a design system being rebuilt to be code- and AI-readable.
  • Coach, grow, and care for a small team of senior designers: modeling the craft, giving sharp feedback, and creating the conditions for them to own outcomes end-to-end.
  • Hire and level thoughtfully as the team grows, keeping the org flat and the talent bar high.
  • Multiply the team’s impact through operating mechanisms (UX audits, opportunity maps, product narratives, design reviews, and clear quality bars) rather than personal output alone.
  • Communicate persuasively upward, including to VP/C-level, grounding proposals in customer evidence and business outcomes.

Who You Are:

  • A senior product-design leader with 10+ years of relevant design experience at technical and product-driven companies (3+ years in people management preferred), and a track record of owning a major product area’s experience and shipping it, ideally in complex, data-dense, or expert-user domains.
  • Strong, well-argued opinions held with humility: you shape direction and create healthy friction, and you update your view when the evidence changes.
  • Genuine AI-native product judgment: not just content generation, but designing for trust, control, and workflow transformation in agentic and probabilistic systems.
  • Hands-on craft and technical fluency: comfortable prototyping in code (React / modern front-end an advantage) and using AI tools in your workflow; credible to designers and engineers alike.
  • People leadership: evidence you can model, coach, and care for a team, not only align stakeholders. (For candidates newer to formal management, we’ll look for strong player-coach signals and a real motivation to develop others.)
  • Excellent communication and collaboration with both technical and non-technical partners, and comfort operating in ambiguity across teams.
  • Curiosity about (or experience in) financial services, fintech, or other high-stakes professional domains. Domain expertise is a strong plus; a serious, humble approach to ramping into it is essential.

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

Base Compensation Range

$224,000—$308,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

jobs.jobDescription:
Natera is seeking an Associate Director to lead a team in the Oncology R&D organization. You will oversee the planning and execution of development of AI-based diagnostic algorithms, taking them through the development phase, analytical validation and into commercial launch. You will hire and manage the team, support its professional growth, and set the development strategy for new products.

The role calls for extensive experience in algorithm development, NGS data processing across DNA, RNA and methylation, H&E image processing, and the full life cycle of diagnostic product development in a regulated setting. You will implement methods to optimize performance and help define the product profile from a computational perspective, with input from cross-functional teams.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership and Development: Lead, hire and mentor a team of Bioinformatics Scientists. Own their professional growth, their responsibilities, and build a culture of scientific rigor.
  • Development Strategy: Own the development strategy behind new products, from scoping through execution. Work with cross-functional stakeholders on what the team takes on and in what order.
  • Development To Launch: Lead algorithms through the development phase to CLIA readiness. This includes locking the algorithm and its intended use, supporting analytical validation studies by setting performance targets and acceptance criteria in collaboration with the biostatistics team. You will also support clinical validation and produce the documentation that quality, regulatory, and laboratory directors need to release the test.
  • Model Robustness and Performance: Develop and improve biomarker models and classifiers across modalities. Establish strategies for quality control, generalization across sites, scanners, and sequencing runs, and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Production Readiness and Handoff: Move research prototypes into stable, validated production workflows. Hold the team to software engineering practice, including version control, testing, and containerization, and reproducibility under change control. Automate the routine parts of research data management, and reporting so the team's time goes to science.
  • Ways of Working: AI is a routine part of the work here. As the leader of this team, you set what correct use looks like: what an agent may conclude on its own, and what requires a scientist to sign off.
  • Cross-functional Partnership: Work with data science, molecular biology, pipeline engineering, biostatistics, quality assurance, and laboratory operations on new products and on the transition of research work into production. Act as the subject-matter expert those groups come to, and explain findings and the roadmap clearly at every level of the company.

Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Biostatistics, or a related field. (An M.S. with equivalent experience considered).
  • 7+ years in bioinformatics, including 3+ years leading scientists and working across functions.
  • Demonstrated experience developing algorithms from multimodal data including, DNA, RNA and/or methylation sequencing data, digital pathology for clinical diagnostic use.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a team that took an algorithm from research into real clinical use, including a successful CLIA or comparable regulated release, not only to a result.
  • Working knowledge of analytical validation for algorithms, including accuracy, precision, sensitivity, limit of detection, and reproducibility.

Preferred:

  • Deep expertise in next-generation sequencing analysis: hybrid-capture or amplicon-based target enrichment designs, sequencing quality control, secondary analysis, and variant calling.
  • Experience integrating multimodal data (DNA, RNA, histology and other omics data), into a single predictive model or classifier.
  • Working knowledge of how a diagnostic product moves through development in a regulated, accredited setting, including the practices and standards that apply (CLIA, CAP, design controls, and software validation and change control).
  • Strong Python, programming, and data analysis skills, with experience in machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
  • Cloud computing (AWS, GCP) and workflow orchestration (WDL, Nextflow).
  • Containerization (Docker) for reproducible, production-grade analyses.
  • Clear communication of technical detail to people who do not share your background.
  • The ability to run several objectives and timelines at once without close supervision.
  • A desire to work in a fast-paced environment where a small team has high impact.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$177,800—$222,800 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Freshpaint:

Healthcare is a $4+ trillion industry in the U.S. alone, and it’s undergoing a rapid digital transformation.

Hospitals, digital health companies, and life sciences organizations rely on analytics and advertising tools to reach patients, measure performance, and grow. But those tools weren’t built for regulated healthcare data. That creates real compliance risk and forces teams to choose between growth and privacy.

Freshpaint eliminates that trade-off.

We’re a privacy-first data platform that helps healthcare organizations use modern marketing and analytics tools without exposing protected health information (PHI). Freshpaint sits between a company’s website or app and the third-party tools they use, automatically detecting and controlling sensitive data before it’s shared.

In short: we let healthcare teams move fast, safely.

Backed by Top Investors

Freshpaint is backed by some of the most respected names in technology, including:

  • Y Combinator (OpenAI, Stripe, Airbnb, Coinbase, DoorDash)

  • Intel Capital (Broadcom, Astera Labs, VMware, RedHat, MongoDB)

We’ve raised tens of millions of dollars in funding to build the privacy infrastructure layer for healthcare’s digital future.

Who we’re looking for
We’re looking for a driven, aspiring seller who wants to build a career in sales and get very good, fast. You don’t need years of experience. You do need drive, discipline, and the curiosity to learn a complex space. The right person is competitive, coachable, resilient, and relentless: they can take a “no” on a cold call and pick up the phone again with the same energy. They want to understand why healthcare marketing is hard (HIPAA, tracking pixels, privacy risk) and can turn that into short, sharp outreach that gets a busy executive’s attention. They run their own day in a remote environment, apply feedback on the very next call, and see progress as part of winning.

What you’ll be doing
As an SDR on our Provider team, you’ll build net-new pipeline by booking first meetings with marketing, digital, and privacy leaders at health systems and specialty groups. These are the people who decide how patient data is used in marketing, and your work gives our Provider AEs a steady flow of high-quality first conversations. You’ll start with a structured 2-week onboarding bootcamp, get certified on our pitch and objection handling, and be fully ramped by the end of your second month. After that, it’s about steady results: high activity, real personalization, and clean execution.

Primary responsibilities

  • Ramp quickly: complete onboarding and certification, book your first qualified meeting within 30 days, and hit full quota by the end of Month 3

  • Book qualified first meetings and source new opportunities with marketing, digital, and privacy leaders at health systems and specialty groups

  • Consistently hit quota after ramp (roughly 5–6 opportunities and 10 meetings per month)

  • Help source $1.6M+ in qualified Provider pipeline in your first two full quarters

  • Own your weekly activity: 400 calls, 75 net-new prospects added to sequence, and 10+ live conversations

  • Research accounts using ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and news triggers to write outreach that references something real about the account

  • Invite target accounts to Freshpaint-led events (Growth Clinics, House Calls, webinars) and turn attendees into opportunities

  • Keep HubSpot clean: log every activity, book through the right flow, and make sure every meeting is attributed correctly

  • Review your own calls in Gong, take coaching, and keep improving your messaging

Desired skills & experience

  • Up to 1 year of SDR, BDR, or outbound sales experience, or a background in a target-driven, customer-facing role and a clear reason you want to be in sales

  • Comfortable with high-volume cold calling; rejection doesn’t slow you down

  • Aggressive in pursuit of expanding your knowledge & becoming a subject matter expert

  • You own your development: You don’t wait for your manager to find your gaps and help you solve for them. You analyze self performance and spot the areas for growth and build action plans around them.

  • Strong, concise writing: you can write a short, direct email a VP would actually read

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn a new, regulated industry in depth (no technical background required)

  • Organized and process-minded; you see CRM hygiene as part of doing the job well

  • Self-starter who can manage your own schedule in a fully remote environment and asks for help early

  • Coachable: you look for feedback and act on it fast

  • Se

  • Adaptable in a startup where priorities, products, and plays change often

Nice to haves

  • Exposure to healthcare, health tech, or another regulated industry

  • Experience with HubSpot (CRM and sequences), Gong, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

  • Familiarity with digital marketing concepts like ad platforms, analytics, or tracking pixels

  • A track record of competing and winning, whether in sales, athletics, or something else

Perks & Benefits

We take care of our team—here’s a peek at what you get when you join:

  • Competitive pay + generous equity

  • Half-day Fridays, every Friday

  • 16 weeks fully paid parental leave (eligible after 6 months; commission-based roles receive 100% base salary during leave)

  • Flexible PTO with a required 2-week minimum

  • Top-tier health, dental & vision (100% covered for you, 80% for dependents)

  • Intentional & engaging company offsites (past trips: Arizona, Jackson Hole, Nashville, New Orleans & more)

And more! Check out our careers page for the full list.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process around 10 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Risk Operations Center, the AI platform where lean security teams run cyber risk end to end. It combines security ratings, threat intelligence and AI agents to give teams one view of risk across their vendors, attack surface and workforce.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Why are we hiring for this role?

UpGuard is a global leader in cybersecurity, with products spanning attack surface management, third-party risk management, shadow AI, and threat detection. For over 10 years we've worked with many of the world's largest organizations, including [notable customers or customer count, if allowed]. The US market is a key driver of our growth, and we're expanding our North America sales organization to keep pace.

We're looking for a Regional Sales Manager to join our Sales leadership team and [lead a newly formed team / take over an existing team] of Account Executives. You'll report to UpGuard's Head of Sales, North America. Our sales teams focus on new customer acquisition, bringing our SaaS platform to new customers and driving the company forward.

What will you accomplish?

You'll build, coach, and lead all net-new logo activity for a team of Account Executives covering SME, Mid Market, and Emerging Enterprise accounts. Typical deals range from $40k with a 80-90 day sales cycle. In this role, you will:

  • Own and deliver a team quota of ~$1.4M, using forecasting, pipeline analysis, and sales data to spot trends and hit revenue targets consistently.

  • Hire, onboard, and develop a team of around 7 Account Executives, turning new hires into top performers and keeping your best people.

  • Run weekly forecast calls, 1:1s, Gong call reviews, and pipeline hygiene audits, partnering with our Enablement team to fix friction points in the sales cycle.

  • Join customer calls to move complex deals forward, and run sales cycles directly when needed.

  • Lead team meetings on training, enablement, and performance, and contribute to company offsites and leadership initiatives.

  • Work closely with SDRs, Sales Engineering, RevOps, and Customer Success in a low-ego, highly collaborative environment.

What do we need from you?

  • 2+ years of direct people management of a B2B SaaS sales team (not team lead or IC experience), with a track record of hiring, onboarding, and developing reps at different skill levels.

  • Experience selling complex B2B SaaS solutions

  • Hands-on fluency with MEDDPICC and a commitment to rigorous deal qualification and pipeline hygiene.

  • Accurate quarterly and weekly forecasting.

  • A practical, hands-on approach: you're comfortable reviewing calls, leading training, and joining customer meetings.

  • Experience using HubSpot and revenue intelligence tools such as Gong to coach reps and manage pipeline health.

  • A strong communicator who cuts through complexity and builds trust across Sales, Sales Engineering, RevOps, and CS.

  • Willingness to travel up to ~3 trips a quarter for quarterly company offsites, key in-person customer meetings, and conferences.

What will give you an edge?

  • Cybersecurity or third-party risk management experience.

  • A history of developing SDRs into AEs, or AEs into leaders.

What's in it for you?

  • Monthly Lifestyle subsidy:Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being

  • WFH set-up allowance:To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

  • $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance

  • Annual leave:PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

  • 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role

  • Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave

  • Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance

  • Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role

  • Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work.

  • Health Insurance: Access to comprehensive coverage.

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Please Note: Not all roles can be performed from the United States. Please check your specific job listing to confirm its advertised location. If the role you are applying for is listed as based in the US, we are currently only able to support hiring in the following locations: CA, CO, FL, IL, MA, MD, MO, OR, PA, TX, WA, and DC.

jobs.jobDescription:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team

AlphaSense's Product team stands at the forefront of innovation, developing AI-powered solutions that enable professionals to make smarter, faster, and more informed decisions. Our team, a diverse and global collective of operators, craftspeople, innovators, and visionaries, shares a passion for solving complex problems and delivering exceptional user experiences.

If you're passionate about creating industry-leading tools that shape the future of business intelligence, we'd love to meet you.

About the Role

We are seeking a senior, deeply technical product leader to own Search and Curated Experiences AlphaSense. Search is the front door to a corpus of hundreds of millions of business documents, and the relevance, ranking, document-type coverage, filtering, and performance you own sit underneath every product surface. Curated Experiences define how AlphaSense’s content, functionality, and intelligence show up in pre-built experiences that act as a launchpad for our customers’ research - everything from company profiles and industry profiles, to monitoring and beyond.

This is a leadership role, not a feature role. You will set the search strategy, own the metrics, and be the person the organization turns to drive impact with both Search and Curated Experiences. You will lead a small team, including a domain-expert for Curated Experiences. We expect you to own these programs end to end, with the judgment, drive, and initiative to take them all the way.

What You'll Do

  • Own both Search and Curated Experiences: Relevance, ranking, query understanding, document-type coverage, filters, latency, and reliability across every surface that depends on search are your ownership areas, alongside adoption and engagement of company profiles and future new curated experiences.

  • Define the strategy: Set and defend a roadmap that balances relevance quality, coverage, and performance against clear business priorities.

  • Build evaluation and measurement: Stand up the metrics, benchmarks, and experimentation needed to know whether search is getting better, and to prove it.

  • Collaborate across teams: Partner closely with Knowledge Graph, SuperAnalyst / AI, Engineering, and Design so that search and the experiences built on top of it move together.

  • Lead and grow a team: Manage and mentor the curated-experiences / domain-expert PM, set clear ownership, and raise the bar for the search org as it grows.

  • Execute and deliver: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle - from strategy and experimentation through launch, post-launch analysis, and iteration.

Who You Are

  • Deeply Technical: You have built search and relevance systems at scale - e.g., a Google Search-caliber background or equivalent depth in ranking, retrieval, query understanding, and evaluation. You can reason fluently about representation, freshness, quality, and system-design tradeoffs.

  • Strong Ownership & Drive: You take programs end to end and operate autonomously. You set direction, make the calls, and are accountable for the outcome.

  • A People Leader: You can manage and grow PMs, set clear lines of ownership, and resolve ambiguity rather than create it.

  • Analytical & Data-Driven: You balance business goals with technical capability and let metrics, not opinion, settle questions of search quality.

  • Strong Customer Orientation: You understand how sophisticated users search and form conviction, and you use interviews, usability testing, and behavioral data to validate hypotheses.

  • Clear Communicator: You can align engineering, design, and product marketing around a roadmap and gain buy-in to drive high-impact work.

  • Domain Experience a Plus: Direct experience in financial services, capital markets, or with our core customers (financial services, corporate strategy, consulting) is a plus, but not required.

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

Base Compensation Range

$275,000—$290,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

The OSP Licensing & Permitting Specialist is responsible for obtaining, managing, and maintaining permits and approvals required for outside plant fiber and utility infrastructure projects. This role supports the successful delivery of OSP construction by coordinating with municipalities, utility companies, and regulatory agencies to ensure compliance with permitting requirements, joint use agreements, and project schedules.

Essential Job Functions:

License & Permit Application Management:
• Determines required permits based on project scope, OSP design, and jurisdiction
• Performs jurisdictional research
• Prepares, submits, tracks, and closes permits and applications for OSP construction (fiber, conduit, aerial and underground facilities)
• Reviews engineering and construction/permit drawings for permitting compliance
• Ensures compliance with Right-of-Way (ROW), easement, and environmental requirements
• Performs and/or coordinates Make Ready Engineering (MRE) activities, including clearance analysis and utility coordination
• Reviews, coordinates, and validates pole loading analysis (PLA) to ensure structural compliance with joint use and utility standards
• Coordinates with pole owning utilities regarding pole attachment requirements, relocations, replacement, and make ready timelines
• Tracks permit status, conditions, fees, and expiration dates
• Responds to agency comments and revises applications as needed
• Advises engineering on design changes required for permit approvals

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Diep Nguyen, VP Finance here at Customer.io, and I am looking for an Accounting Manager to partner with the Controller on our month-end close and serve as first-level reviewer for the accounting team. We're a global, remote-first, private company built on subscription and usage-based revenue, with a finance stack that includes NetSuite and FloQast, and we use AI throughout the business, including in Finance. Our accounting team covers revenue accounting, close, AP/AR, payroll, and treasury. You'll report to the Controller and work closely with partners in Sales, Legal, IT, People, and Engineering.

What we value

  • Ownership — You own a process from source data through the financial statements.
  • Curiosity — You keep asking why until you find the system behind the break.
  • A data-backed voice — You bring findings and recommendations to business owners with numbers behind them.
  • Practical AI use — You apply AI to speed up accounting work, with documented human review.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with the Controller on the monthly and quarterly close in FloQast, tracking deadlines and sign-offs, and help shorten the close through process improvements and AI.
  • Review and approve journal entries and reconciliations prepared by others on the accounting team, including cash, accounts receivable, prepaids, deferred commissions, fixed assets, accruals, deferred revenue, and payroll liabilities, and propose the bad debt reserve for Controller approval.
  • Draft the monthly flux analysis with root-cause explanations for material variances, assemble the close review folder, and support the Controller in the review with the VP Finance and CFO.
  • Assist the Senior Revenue Manager with revenue recognition (ASC 606), including deferred revenue, overage accruals, and usage true-ups.
  • Review AP, card, and payroll accruals and entries to confirm liabilities are recorded completely.
  • Prepare audit schedules for our external auditors and help document and test close controls with the Controller.
  • Coach the accountants who prepare the close, and apply AI tools to flux analysis, accrual review, and reconciliation matching with documented human review.

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 2 years reviewing the work of others or managing accountants
  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field
  • Hands-on month-end close experience at a SaaS company, including reviewing journal entries and reconciliations in an ERP such as NetSuite
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP for the accounts you will review, including accruals and unrecorded liabilities, prepaids, fixed assets, and payroll and commission liabilities, with specific knowledge of the allowance for credit losses (ASC 326), capitalized sales commissions (ASC 340-40), and the evaluation of errors and their materiality (ASC 250)
  • Experience supporting an external audit, including preparing schedules and responding to auditor requests
  • A specific example of using AI to make an accounting process or the close more efficient, which you built or deployed, and what it changed
  • Clear written and verbal communication with non-finance partners, and the judgment to know when to escalate to the Controller
  • Nice to have: CPA license (active or inactive) or a Big 4 or public accounting background; experience with NetSuite, FloQast, and usage-based billing; SOX or internal controls exposure; and remote-first company experience

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $105k–$122k USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  1. 30-minute video call with a Recruiter
  2. 30-minute video call with the Hiring Manager
  3. 30-minute 1:1 video call with a team member
  4. 60-minute case review and panel interview

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read — apply now.

About Lantern

Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. By curating a Network of Excellence comprised of the nation's top specialists for surgery, cancer care, infusions and more, Lantern delivers excellent care with significant cost savings to employers and their workforces. Lantern also pairs members with a dedicated care team, including Care Advocates and nurses, for the entirety of their care journey, helping them get back to good health, back to their families and back to work. With convenient access to specialists nationwide, Lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. Lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. Learn more about us at lanterncare.com.

Director, Solutions Architect (Health Plans)

*This is an individual contributor role*

Lantern is looking for a Director, Solutions Architect to join our fast-growing team. This is an individual contributor Solutions Consultant-like role serving as a trusted advisor and solutions leader, partnering with Health Plan Sales leadership to drive and win new business. The individual will leverage deep health plan and vendor expertise to design creative, scalable solutions and integration strategies, particularly in risk products, that align with partner goals and operational priorities. Acting as the bridge between business challenges and technical/product solutions, this role will collaborate cross-functionally to shape infrastructure for growth, manage new initiative intake, resolve escalations, and inform go to market and implementation strategy. Success requires balancing detailed technical and financial conversations along with strategic, executive-level discussions, fostering strong stakeholder relationships, and championing innovative approaches that maintain long-term business growth.

Location: Remote; travel required

Responsibilities:

  • Act as a trusted advisor by partnering closely with the rest of the health plan sales team on qualified partnership opportunities, serving as the solution SME and strategic thought partner to drive and win new business.
  • Leverage deep health plan and vendor experience to design creative, and scalable solutions to both technical and nontechnical problems and obstacles that integrate seamlessly with health plan ecosystem partner operations and priorities.
  • Consult, develop and implement comprehensive product solutions and integration strategies aligned with health plan goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to identify and influence infrastructure needs that enable future business growth and operational scalability.
  • Serve as the internal leader and project manager of solutions while your counterpart VP of Health Plan Sales serves as the external lead.
  • Establish and manage a structured intake process for new health plan growth initiatives, ensuring prioritization, visibility, and efficient execution.
  • Lead resolution of prospect and partner escalations by working closely with internal teams and external stakeholders to enhance service delivery and trust.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders to foster collaboration and ensure operational success.
  • Ensure health plan contracts align with operational goals, performance metrics, and service-level agreements to drive improved partner retention.
  • Monitor industry and competitive trends, recommending and implementing innovative solutions to meet the evolving needs of health plans.
  • Demonstrate the ability to flex between deep technical discussions with specialized audiences and higher-level strategic conversations with non-technical executive stakeholders.
  • Champion forward-looking, differentiated strategies that enhance competitiveness and support sustainable business growth

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in healthcare, health plans, or health tech, with a strong background in solutioning, product integration/ implementation or vendor/partner management.
  • Experience working directly with health plans and ecosystem partners (e.g., TPAs, PBMs, risk-bearing entities) required.
  • Strong track record of acting as a strategic thought partner to sales and product leaders to drive business growth.
  • Proven success in working with internal cross-functional teams in building and scaling complex solutions.

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of health plan operations, risk products, and integration strategies across the healthcare ecosystem.
  • Ability to serve as a bridge between business needs and technical/product solutions, translating complex requirements into actionable strategies.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with ability to toggle between deep technical discussions and executive-level strategy conversations.
  • Strong analytical orientation, ability to ingest complex data, synthesize and
  • Strong problem-solving and solutioning mindset scrappy, creative, and able to design scalable approaches under ambiguity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage escalations, intake processes, and infrastructure planning to enable organizational growth.
  • Proven ability to build trusted advisor relationships with both internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Ability and willingness to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) to streamline work, improve productivity and execute on work

Other

  • Willingness to travel as needed to support partner engagements and business development (1-3 times quarterly on average)
  • Strong understanding of emerging healthcare and health plan industry trends, with the ability to proactively recommend innovative solutions.

Strong Candidates will:

  • Move Fast: Acting with urgency to respond to health plan and Lantern’s business needs with minimal direction.
  • Be Comfortable in a Fast-Paced Environment: that can be challenging but highly rewarding
  • Be A Strategic Thinker / Problem Solver: both in how we work with health plans to achieve our joint objectives, but also in how they build their function and supporting systems / processes

  • You use LOGIC in your decision making and understand that progress is critical to making change. You focus on the execution of your content while balancing a fast-paced environment and you take the time to celebrate both the small & big wins.

About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

We’re looking for a Solutions Architect to help build the technical foundation that powers Zip’s ERP and integration ecosystem. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the Workday Financials ecosystem.

As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems.

You Will

You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of future implementations are delivered, raising the technical bar for both our EPD teams and our customer-facing technical consultant organization.

  • Architect & standardize Workday integrations: Design, maintain, and iterate on Zip’s core Workday Financials and Procurement integration templates, ensuring they deliver scalable, repeatable, and robust customer implementations.

  • Bridge product & the field: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) to ensure integration templates stay perfectly aligned with core product architecture, field insights, and emerging customer needs.

  • Turn nuance into scale: Analyze complex customer implementations to identify reusable data mapping patterns and system nuances, converting bespoke solutions into standardized internal assets.

  • Support pre-sales engineering: Partner with account teams during pre-sales to design and vet integration architectures, ensuring prospective customers are set up for smooth, best-practice deployments.

  • Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations.

  • Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing Workday, P2P, and financial systems expertise to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio.

  • Build for permanent scale: Approach every technical challenge with an engineering mindset - designing and executing a solution thoroughly once so that future implementations happen effortlessly. You balance high-level architectural design with a willingness to dive directly into API configurations and template modifications to get the job done right.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering integrations with Workday Financials.

  • Strong foundational knowledge of core Workday Financials business processes, data models, and the Foundation Data Model (FDM) layout, specifically within Core Financials, Procurement, and Supplier Accounts.

  • Familiarity with standard Workday integration methods and tools, such as Workday Studio, EIBs, Core Connectors, Web Services (WWS), and RaaS (Reports-as-a-Service).

  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools is preferred, but we welcome candidates with strong core integration logic who can learn new platform tools quickly.

  • Experience working with XML / REST based endpoints and standard authentication protocols.

  • Past ERP implementation, integration, configuration or administration experience is required.

  • Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge.

  • Comfortable working with API documentation.

  • Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors.

  • Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight

  • A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive.

  • Experience working with product and engineering teams.

  • Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement.

The salary range for this role is $126,000 - $170,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 100% health, vision & dental coverage options

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 🏋️‍♀️ ClassPass membership

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 💻 Home office stipend

  • 🛜 Phone/internet reimbursement

  • 🍼 Paid parental leave

  • 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Fertility stipend

  • 💸 401k plan

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

Immunome is a clinical-stage targeted oncology company committed to developing first-in-class and best-in-class targeted cancer therapies. We are advancing an innovative portfolio of therapeutics, supported by a leadership team with deep experience in the design, development, and commercialization of cutting-edge therapies, including antibody-drug conjugates. Our pipeline includes varegacestat, an investigational gamma secretase inhibitor for which an NDA has been accepted by the U.S. FDA; IM-1021, a clinical-stage ROR1 ADC; IM-1617, a clinical-stage solid tumor ADC; and IM-3050, a clinical-stage FAP-targeted radioligand therapy. We are also advancing a broad portfolio of early-stage ADCs pursuing undisclosed solid tumor targets.

Position Overview

Immunome is seeking a highly experienced and strategic National Account Director, Enterprise Access to lead integrated account strategy across a U.S. national footprint in support of our oncology portfolio. This role will build and sustain relationships with national and regional health plans, pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs), and Key Account customer networks to advance launch readiness, appropriate coverage and reimbursement, formulary access, and therapeutic adoption following regulatory approval.

The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in payer access and institutional purchasing, recognizing the distinct operating models, decision processes, and account economics of each. This position combines direct account ownership, strategic negotiation, and executive relationship management with cross-functional leadership, serving as a primary resource for field teams and connecting headquarters strategy with local execution.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute multi-year Payer / PBM and Key Account institution plans with defined access objectives, stakeholder engagement, procurement strategies, and measures of success.
  • Apply commercial, Medicare Part D, and Medicaid expertise alongside community and integrated delivery network (IDN) business acumen, tailoring strategies to payer coverage decisions and provider purchasing structures.
  • Translate oncology market trends, clinical differentiation, reimbursement, and clinical pathway dynamics into national account priorities and commercial planning.

Payer Access and Stakeholder Management

  • Build executive-level relationships with pharmacy directors, medical directors, clinical leaders, and pharmacy and therapeutics (P&T) decision-makers across national and regional health plans and PBMs.
  • Navigate formulary and preferred drug list (PDL) development, utilization management, and coverage and reimbursement policies across commercial plans, Medicare Part D, and Medicaid fee-for-service (FFS) programs and managed care organizations (MCOs).
  • Map decision authority and payer affiliates; coordinate internal account teams to identify access barriers, align engagement, and advance appropriate coverage outcomes.

Institutional Access and Stakeholder Management

  • Build relationships with CEOs, CFOs, COOs, medical directors, pharmacists, and practice administrators across oncology customers and their member organizations.
  • Extend engagement to IDNs, health systems, hospital and community oncology networks, and national clinical pathway organizations, aligning corporate relationships with local customer needs.
  • Use approved clinical and economic evidence to support appropriate preferred formulary and pathway positioning with relevant provider and pathway decision-makers, respecting independent clinical decisions.

Strategic Negotiation

  • Lead payer, PBM, and community account strategy and negotiations, including pull-through opportunity, within approved authority; balance coverage and purchasing objectives, rebate commitments, pricing dynamics, and long-term business value.
  • Partner with Market Access, Finance, Legal, and Compliance to evaluate contract economics, 340B considerations, and Medicaid Best Price implications and secure approvals before commitments.
  • Prepare negotiation strategies for sophisticated counterparties, execute approved agreements, and coordinate implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Translate local access and coverage landscape into coordinated field pull-through plans, with clear account responsibilities and adherence to company policies.

Value Communication and Market Intelligence

  • Partner with Medical Affairs and health economics and outcomes research (HEOR) colleagues to translate clinical and economic evidence into account-specific value narratives using approved materials and appropriate scientific support.
  • Tailor compliant communications to payer evidence needs, population priorities, and coverage considerations, and to Key Account, provider, and pathway stakeholders’ clinical and business priorities.
  • Monitor formularies, utilization management, coverage policies, clinical pathways, and oncology market developments; synthesize account insights and evidence gaps into actionable recommendations for internal teams.

Leadership and Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary payer and corporate accounts resource for field sales, connecting headquarters strategy, national agreements, and local execution.
  • Partner with Commercial field and Market Access colleagues on shared accounts, aligning priorities, responsibilities, customer messaging, and coordinated action plans; provide proactive consultation to Sales, Marketing, Medical Affairs, HEOR, Finance, Legal, and Policy.
  • Lead cross-functional account teams and mentor colleagues, fostering accountability, consensus building, and coordinated execution without relying on direct reporting authority.

Launch Planning and Execution

  • Lead payer and key institutional account launch readiness, aligning access strategies, contracting timelines, stakeholder engagement, and field execution with applicable regulatory approvals.
  • Develop and execute educational programs through all available channels with appropriate internal partners and review processes, maintaining separation between commercial and medical activities.
  • Tailor rare disease and rare oncology launch strategies to clinical differentiation and account needs rather than relying on approaches designed for large, high-volume therapeutic classes.

Qualifications

  • Significant biopharmaceutical market access or commercial experience managing national or major regional payer accounts and national oncology GPOs.
  • Experience across commercial, Medicare Part D, and Medicaid FFS and MCO markets, as well as community and IDN purchasing structures.
  • Proven account-planning success, senior stakeholder relationships, and appropriate coverage, formulary or pathway outcomes and field pull-through.
  • Experience leading payer, PBM, and oncology negotiations and evaluating pricing and contracting implications with Finance and Legal.
  • Experience communicating clinical and HEOR evidence with Medical Affairs support and developing educational programs through appropriate channels.
  • Demonstrated success working in a highly matrixed environment influencing cross-functional strategy, and coaching or mentoring colleagues.
  • Prior product-launch experience required, including account readiness and coordinated field execution.
  • Rare disease or rare oncology experience strongly preferred, with examples of account differentiation from large, high-volume therapeutic classes.
  • Ability to engage customers nationally; ability to travel up to 50%.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Deep knowledge of payer and PBM business models, revenues and incentives, and how insurance-side coverage differs from community and IDN purchasing.
  • Knowledge of formulary and PDL development, utilization management, reimbursement policies, and provider formulary and clinical pathway decisions.
  • Financial and contracting acumen across rebates, pricing, 340B, Medicaid Best Price, and key account economics.
  • Deep oncology therapeutic-area knowledge, including biologic and biosimilar access dynamics where relevant.
  • Ability to translate clinical and HEOR evidence into account-specific value narratives and identify evidence gaps with subject matter experts.
  • Executive presence, sound judgment, negotiation, stakeholder mapping, and relationship management skills across complex payer and provider accounts.
  • Cross-functional leadership and influence, including consultation, consensus building, mentoring, and collaboration across headquarters and field teams.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, strategic planning, and problem-solving skills; accountability and effective prioritization in a dynamic biotech environment.

Washington State Pay Range

$240,000—$269,908 USD

Join Our Experienced, Passionate Team

Working at Immunome gives you the opportunity to make a difference in the lives of cancer patients, contribute to developing best-in-class targeted cancer therapies, and work with some of the brightest and most experienced minds in antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) development.

Immunome’s office is charged with the collective excitement and passion of people working together to develop life-changing cancer medicines. Our team thrives in an innovative, collaborative environment where employees are empowered to do their best work.

Immunome also offers a comprehensive benefit program for you and your family, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for employees and their dependents, including 100% company-paid medical premiums for employees
  • A 401(k) with employer match
  • Employer-paid life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, and AD&D
  • Paid time off, company holidays, and a week-long winter break between Christmas and New Years.
  • Paid parental leave

E/E/O

Immunome, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

E-Verify

Immunome, Inc. is a participant in E-Verify. Please review the following notices: E-Verify Participation Poster | Right to Work Poster (English) | Right to Work Poster (Spanish).

jobs.jobDescription:
The National Real Estate Practice Leader is responsible for advancing IMA’s national presence, growth, and expertise across the real estate industry. This leader brings deep knowledge of real estate risks, sophisticated carrier and market relationships, and a strategic mindset oriented around complex property portfolios, development activity, and evolving economic and regulatory conditions. The leader serves as a highly visible resource across geographies and builds a durable practice capability that markets, producers, service teams, and clients can use across IMA.

Essential Responsibilities:

Growth, Production & Market Impact

  • Drive national new business growth across priority real estate sectors, which may include multifamily, affordable housing, commercial office, industrial and logistics, retail, mixed-use, hospitality, development, and property management.
  • Actively support producers on complex real estate opportunities, including strategy, program structure, property and catastrophe risk, valuation, builder’s risk, casualty, environmental risk, cyber, management liability, claims, and alternative risk considerations.
  • Provide direct involvement on high-value pursuits, including complex portfolios, catastrophe-exposed assets, development projects, and organizations with sophisticated risk financing needs.
  • Participate in internal business reviews, prospect meetings, client presentations, and RFP responses, representing IMA’s national real estate expertise.
  • Bring forward timely insights on real estate, capital markets, insurance conditions, regulatory developments, climate risk, construction costs, and economic trends, and apply them to client and growth strategy.

Real Estate Specialty Strategy & National Alignment

  • Develop and execute the national strategic plan for the Real Estate Practice, ensuring alignment with IMA’s enterprise growth priorities.
  • Establish a clear point of view on priority client segments, geographic opportunities, differentiation, investment needs, and where the practice can win.
  • Partner with market and sales leaders to translate opportunity into focused plans with outcomes, owners, milestones, talent needs, service needs, and resource requirements.
  • Align service standards, technical expectations, and client delivery models across participating IMA markets to support a consistent client experience.
  • Assess the current state of the practice and recommend where to scale, strengthen, incubate, maintain, partner, or stop.

Carrier, Market & Industry Relationships

  • Build and maintain deep relationships with property and casualty carriers, wholesale and program partners, alternative risk providers, and other markets relevant to real estate clients.
  • Strengthen market access and carrier alignment for complex portfolios, catastrophe-exposed assets, development projects, and difficult or specialized risks.
  • Build trusted relationships with real estate associations, centers of influence, lenders, capital partners, and other industry stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with carrier and external partners to bring useful market intelligence, benchmarking, risk insights, and new solutions to IMA’s clients and internal teams.
  • Represent IMA in relevant real estate forums and bring emerging client needs, market changes, and partnership opportunities back into the organization.

Talent Development & Capability Building

  • Define the production, service, technical, analytics, claims, risk control, and leadership capabilities required for the practice to succeed.
  • Actively support specialty recruiting by identifying talent pools, target organizations, role profiles, and high-potential candidates, and by participating in interviews and selection.
  • Partner with Market Presidents and business leaders on onboarding, deployment, development, promotion, and retention of real estate talent.
  • Mentor and develop real estate-specialized talent across production, account management, technical placement, analytics, claims, and risk control.
  • Build a sustainable national bench of real estate experts and future leaders, with deliberate development and succession planning.
  • Reduce reliance on any one individual or market by converting expertise into repeatable solutions, playbooks, tools, training, service standards, and delivery models.

Collaboration, Growth Enablement & Internal Integration

  • Serve as a consultative growth partner to Market Presidents, Commercial Lines leaders, sales leaders, producers, and client teams.
  • Engage early in strategic prospects, complex client needs, and major opportunities to pressure-test assumptions, shape pursuit strategy, and connect the right expertise and resources.
  • Increase producer confidence and effectiveness through real estate insight, practical coaching, relationship support, and clear access to practice resources.
  • Lead national practice calls and cross-market collaboration, promoting knowledge sharing and the transfer of proven approaches across IMA.
  • Partner with Marketing on focused thought leadership, events, association involvement, and market-facing content aligned with practice strategy.
  • Help markets replicate proven growth plays while adapting them to local asset classes, relationships, talent, and execution realities.

Performance, Accountability & Enterprise Leadership

  • Establish meaningful goals and expectations for growth, talent, capability, client value, activity, and execution.
  • Maintain a regular review cadence with market and enterprise stakeholders, surface risks and barriers early, and recommend adjustments based on evidence.
  • Create shared accountability across specialty, market, sales, and service leadership by clarifying ownership, milestones, resource needs, and decision points.
  • Represent the practice in enterprise planning and provide an objective view of opportunity, capacity, performance, and investment needs.
  • Measure success through the capability and results of the practice, not simply the individual activity of the Practice Leader.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Extensive real estate-related brokerage, underwriting, risk management, consulting, or adjacent experience, with strong technical knowledge of real estate exposures and insurance solutions.
  • Demonstrated credibility across relevant real estate sectors, client operating models, risk exposures, insurance markets, and competitive dynamics.
  • Experience supporting complex real estate portfolios, sophisticated placements, development projects, strategic pursuits, or industry-specific solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of property and catastrophe risk, valuation, builder’s risk, complex casualty, contractual risk transfer, claims, and alternative risk considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build senior-level relationships with real estate executives, clients, carrier leaders, associations, centers of influence, and strategic partners.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence across markets, functions, and reporting lines.
  • Experience recruiting, developing, mentoring, or deploying specialized talent.
  • Ability to convert technical knowledge into practical solutions, clear communication, scalable tools, and measurable growth or client value.

Competencies

  • Real Estate Industry and Business Acumen
  • Strategic Leadership and Commercial Judgment
  • Capability Building and Talent Development
  • Market Partnership and Growth Enablement
  • Relationship Building with Real Estate Executives, Carriers, and Industry Partners
  • Complex Client and Pursuit Leadership
  • Enterprise Collaboration and Shared Accountability
  • Effective Communication and Executive Presence
  • Execution Discipline and Follow-Through
