About Us:

Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting.

Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less.

Senior Product Manager II, Fraud & Identity (Remote – USA / CANADA)

Do you get energized by thinking like a bad actor so you can build the products that catch them? Is turning good analysis into a shipped, prioritized roadmap the thing you're proudest of, more than the analysis itself? Then this is the role for you.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager II to lead fraud and identity/authentication together at Wrapbook; two domains that lean on the same signals and the same underlying infrastructure, and work best under one owner. You'll define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for how we detect, prevent, and respond to fraud, and how we verify and protect identity, across the full customer lifecycle. This is a hands-on, build-with-engineers role, not a hand-it-off-and-wait one.

Fraud and identity also touch other teams' domains (company setup, worker onboarding, vendor payments, and more), so you'll work across those wherever it's relevant, bringing your Fraud expertise to influence and orchestrate a holistic, seamless fraud and identity customer experience. You'll also partner with the Legal & GRC team with your solutions as you own the tech that powers Wrapbook's KYC and AML compliance. You'll guide fraud operations (triage, investigation, case handling), enabling your partners in the Client Operations org. You own the product decisions: what gets detected, prevented, and surfaced to customers, and in what order. You'll report to the Senior Manager of Product Management, Onboarding & Lifecycle.

What you'll do:

  • Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for fraud and identity/authentication across the customer lifecycle — from prevention to detection to response.

  • Prioritize and sequence the joint fraud + identity roadmap, weighing input across the teams whose backlogs it depends on.

  • Work directly with engineers on scoring logic and rules. Read a schema, reason about what a signal actually discriminates, and tell a good-sounding signal from a useful one.

  • Turn analysis into decisions that ship. Write decision docs that carry a clear recommendation and get acted on — not a comprehensive list of options with no ranking.

  • Act as incident commander for fraud incidents, coordinating engineering, Client Ops, GRC, Treasury, and Security, and evolve the playbooks so others can step in.

  • Define and instrument the fraud and identity health metrics that matter most — spanning detection accuracy, authentication coverage, and the customer friction it creates.

  • Say no upward, with evidence, when a new signal, a vendor, or a broad enforcement change would spend the friction budget without reducing real risk.

  • Partner with Legal/GRC on the compliance-adjacent surface your product touches (KYC/AML posture, audit walkthroughs) without taking on the compliance function itself.

What you'll have:

  • Owned a fraud, risk, or identity product surface at a payments, fintech, or marketplace company — not adjacent to it, owned it.

  • Real fluency in detection tradeoffs: precision vs. recall, the true cost of a false positive, and the idea of a finite friction budget.

  • Comfort working directly with engineers on scoring logic and schemas, not just briefing them and waiting.

  • Experience running or co-running incident response, with the instinct that the expensive part of fraud is the operational orchestration, not the detection build.

  • AI fluency/demonstrated experience working with/building with AI; using AI to increase the speed, accuracy, and automation throughout the fraud lifecycle.

  • A track record of decision docs that got decided and turned into shipped work, not just documented.

  • Experience in build/buy decisions around fraud platforms.

  • Comfortable pushing back on senior stakeholders with evidence, rather than deferring or complying by default.

  • Excellent written communication — Wrapbook is a document-forward, remote-first culture, and your writing is how people experience your thinking.

Extra Points If You Have:

  • You have any advanced financial industry certifications — CPA, CFA, CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), etc.

  • You have payroll, payments, or other money-movement experience.

  • You have KYC/AML domain knowledge, or vendor/AP fraud experience.

  • You have hands-on experience with Auth0 or a comparable identity platform.

  • You have exposure to synthetic and AI-generated identity fraud patterns.

  • You love wearing a lot of hats and rolling up your sleeves to be hands-on with solving fraud problems.

This is a remote position open to candidates located in the United States or Canada. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas or work permits for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country from which they will perform the work.

Why Join Us

At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology — and not just in the product.

In addition to a competitive salary and all the benefits you can expect from a fast-growing technology company, you’ll get access to a team of creative problem solvers and the chance to see your contributions make large impacts. Benefits include:

jobs.jobDescription:
Overview

Smartling is an AI-native translation platform that's redefining how the world's biggest brands go global — ranked #3 on Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list. We're growing rapidly at scale and are backed by Battery Ventures, a global technology-focused investment firm. While most companies are still figuring out how to use AI, we've spent years building it into the core of our platform — and we're just getting started.

The Web Integrations Support Engineer is part of the Professional Services team at Smartling. The mission of the team is to help customers rapidly integrate Smartling solutions in a way that is sustainable and scalable. You will be responsible for ongoing maintenance of customer integrations based on Smartling’s GDN (web proxy) solution to ensure that the integration continues to meet customer needs as their sites change over time.

We are looking for a professional with a track record of successfully supporting enterprise-grade technical solutions, who can communicate complex concepts and ideas effectively, and who takes a systematic troubleshooting approach when dealing with live customer issues. We are currently considering candidates based in the Pacific and Mountain time zones.

You Will

  • Own customer tickets end to end, with clear written root-cause explanations and next steps
  • Run troubleshooting sessions and workshops with customer engineering teams, advising them on integration best practices
  • Escalate to and collaborate with Engineering with clear reproduction steps when an issue needs a product fix
  • Build scripts and tooling, to make diagnosis and configuration faster and safer
  • Work with technical and business stakeholders to understand requirements and recommend sustainable solutions
  • Make changes to live production configuration with care: testing safely, planning for rollback, and telling customers what changed and why
  • Act with precision and urgency when customers are affected, and manage changing scope and ambiguity without losing momentum
  • Keep learning about new web technologies and contribute to process and tooling improvements

You Have

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as Support Engineer, Solutions or Technical Consultant, or similar, focused on technical troubleshooting, solution design or implementation
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with HTTP, HTML, CSS (including writing robust selectors), JavaScript and REST APIs
  • Strong skills with browser DevTools and network debugging, and an understanding of how pages are built and rendered in the browser
  • Working knowledge of proxies, CDNs, web servers, DNS/TLS and caching, plus web security basics (CSP, CORS, cookies, WAFs)
  • Comfort with regular expressions, plus the ability to write scripts (JavaScript, Python or Bash)
  • Experience diagnosing issues from logs and request traces (Quickwit, Grafana, Kibana, Splunk or similar)
  • A methodical, hypothesis-driven approach to complex problems
  • Excellent written and spoken communication, with the ability to advise and persuade both technical and non-technical audiences
  • The ability to drive outcomes despite complexity, ambiguity or shifting priorities

Preferred but not required

  • Experience with modern front-end frameworks (React, Next.js, Vue) and client-side rendering
  • Familiarity with CMS platforms (e.g., AEM, Sitecore, WordPress, Contentful)
  • Hands-on experience with Nginx or similar proxy and web server configuration
  • Knowledge of SEO fundamentals (hreflang, canonical tags, sitemaps)
  • Experience with translation, localization and internationalization, including awareness of RTL and CJK languages, character encoding and locale formatting, and/or fluency in multiple languages
  • Software development experience

You Will Enjoy

  • Freedom 🏡 - we are remote-first
  • Growth - an opportunity to learn and advance your career
  • Wealth 💰 - we offer a competitive salary and 401(k) + company match
  • Wellness - health insurance; free medical plan for you and your family
  • Balance - flexible PTO + 11 holidays; generous parental leave
  • Culture 🤝- an energetic, value-driven, and fun culture and team spirit
  • Bonus - employee referral program and Apple equipment

Smartling is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, skills, and experiences.

We use the E-Verify platform for work authorization verifications.

The US national total pay range for this role is $90,000 - $110,000. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including geographic location as well as candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed.

*To work from home, you must have a strong internet connection, a quiet space, and a professional (distraction and clutter-free) background.

Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less.

The Opportunity - SMB Digital Success Lead - (Remote - USA & Canada)

We're looking for a Sr. SMB Digital Success Lead to build how Wrapbook serves its Commercial SMB customers. You'll own the SMB business end to end and turn it into a proactive success model where onboarding is faster, risks are caught early, and customers get help when it matters — all starting from what customers actually do, at scale.

SMB is where our agent-first approach to Customer Success moves fastest — the segment where you can shape what proactive, AI-powered success looks like. If you'd rather design a model than inherit one, this is a rare shot to set the standard for how a whole segment gets served.

What you'll do:

  • Own the Commercial SMB business (accounts, cases, outreach, and retention) as the single owner and point of contact across Sales, Support, and Partners.

  • Build a success model that catches risk early and drives onboarding, adoption, and expansion across the whole SMB base through AI-assisted engagement.

  • Own SMB onboarding fully: the curriculum, how it's delivered, and the results. Keep improving it based on what the case queue and agent signals tell you about where customers get stuck.

  • Lead the agent rollout for SMB. Work with the AI team to design the model and to build, test, and drive adoption of the AI agents and SMB app. Own every agent that touches SMB, from requirements through adoption.

  • Work with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to grow the SMB portfolio: surface expansion and Mid-Market opportunities, shape adoption campaigns, and align on segmentation and coverage so every account gets the right level of service.

  • Partner with your leader and AI Ops to define what good looks like and execute on the plan to exceed those targets.

  • Be the voice of the SMB customer. Bring product, process, and enablement insights from the front line back to the teams who can act on them.

  • Help scale what works across Commercial Success. Document and share workflows, wins, and playbooks so the approach can grow beyond SMB.

jobs.jobDescription:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The VP of Communications owns how TRM shows up in the world: the corporate narrative, the earned channels that carry it, and the voices across the company that amplify it. Criminals are scaling with AI, and TRM is building to own the AI investigations category. You'll build a dedicated communications function from responsibilities currently shared across the team, set proactive narrative strategy on how modern crime is changing and how it's best fought, so that the market, media, analysts, prospective talent, and investors look to TRM for the definitive view on how AI is changing crime, the capacity gap facing the people who fight it, and how crimefighters close it.

The impact you will have:

  • TRM is known as the company that owns the AI investigations category: one clear corporate narrative, carried consistently by our leaders in the conversations that matter, through an executive-visibility program you design and run

  • TRM's share of voice and quality of coverage grow across media, industry analysts, and our other earned channels, shaping how customers, prospective talent, and investors see the company, built on journalist and analyst relationships you own

  • Subject-matter experts from every function become recognized voices in their fields, carrying TRM's story on stages, in bylines, and across our corporate social channels, because you found them, placed them, prepared them, and gave them the guides and AI-enabled workflows to stay consistent and on-brand

  • TRM responds fast and credibly when reputation is on the line, because the monitoring, playbooks, and AI-assisted media tracking you put in place are ready before they're needed

What we're looking for:

  • 10+ years in corporate and executive communications, including owning earned media, ideally at a security, fintech, intelligence, or regulated-tech company

  • A proactive narrative strategist who has placed high-quality coverage and grown share of voice, not just shipped releases

  • Fluency in building sophisticated, credible corporate narratives about AI: what it changes, where it creates risk, and where your company stands, beyond using AI tools day to day

  • An AI-native approach: you use AI across monitoring, research, drafting, and reporting, and you build workflows others can use

  • A natural teacher and talent-spotter who can find the experts across a company, place them in the right forums, and coach them to be confident in front of press and audiences

  • Comfort building a function and its systems from the ground up, and leading cross-functionally without a large standing team

  • Exposure to a strong crisis-communications program and sound judgment under pressure; you've supported a live issue or two, but your instinct is to put TRM into the conversation, not keep it out

  • An excellent writer and editor who can distill complex, technical topics for press, executives, and the public

About the Team:

  • Reports to the Chief Brand Officer, within Brand & Communications

  • A senior leadership role that consolidates communications responsibilities currently split across several people into one dedicated function

  • Works closely with Policy, Insights, Product Marketing, Brand/Content, company Leadership, and subject-matter experts across the company

  • Manages TRM's PR agency and an APAC-based communications lead (contractor) from day one, with potential to build out a team as the function grows

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • US-based role; you'll build coverage for other time zones through your team and partners, starting with an APAC-based communications lead

  • Weekly marketing and leadership syncs; fast, async-first collaboration with executives and cross-functional partners

  • Clear communication norms and shared message guides so the company stays on-brand

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: Core overlap across US business hours

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Schedule: No formal on-call. Crisis-response availability is expected as issues arise.

Travel Requirements:

  • Schedule: Occasional travel for media, executive events, and team offsites

  • Frequency: Low to moderate (HM to confirm)

Onsite Requirements:

  • Schedule: Distributed; periodic in-person for key moments (HM to confirm)

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 30 days: ship a corporate narrative and messaging architecture, and a plan to consolidate the split comms responsibilities into one function

  • Within 60 days: land a planned earned-media moment, stand up the executive-visibility calendar, and identify the first group of subject-matter experts to develop as thought leaders

  • Within 90 days: have a tested crisis-communications playbook in place and a repeatable, AI-assisted media-monitoring and reporting workflow running

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $195,000-$255,000

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

About Us:

Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting.

Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less.

The Opportunity: Senior Software Engineer II, Applied AI (Remote - USA / Canada)

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer II, Applied AI to join our Agentic Systems team, where you'll build AI agents that automate workflows for teams across Wrapbook. You'll partner directly with internal teams like Marketing, Sales, Support, Operations and Finance to find high-leverage processes, then design, ship and iterate on agents that take real work off their plates. This is a chance to define how a 400+ person company runs on AI. You'll see the impact of your work every day, while shaping the patterns, tools and standards for how we build agents at Wrapbook.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and build production-grade AI agents with LangGraph that automate multi-step workflows for internal teams across Wrapbook

  • Deploy, run and scale agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, using its runtime, memory, identity and gateway capabilities to make them secure and reliable, while tracking what they cost to run and keeping it efficient as usage grows

  • Partner with internal teams to find high-impact workflows, draw out requirements from people who can't hand you a spec, and turn them into agent-driven solutions, explaining clearly what each agent can and can't reliably do

  • Integrate agents with Wrapbook's internal systems, APIs and third-party tools so they can take real actions, not just answer questions

  • Build evaluation, observability and guardrail frameworks to measure agent quality, catch failures and keep humans in the loop where it matters

  • Establish reusable patterns, shared tools and best practices that let the Agentic Systems team ship new agents quickly and consistently

  • Own agents end to end, from prototype to production, measuring their impact on the teams they serve and iterating based on usage data and feedback

  • Drive adoption through clear documentation, training and enablement, so teams understand what each agent does, trust it and know how to get the most from it

What You’ll Have:

  • 6+ years of back-end development experience with Python, TypeScript/Node.js or Java, with a track record of delivering systems built for security, scalability, availability and performance

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered agents or workflows (with models such as Claude, GPT, Llama or Mistral), including prompting, tool use and structured outputs. You can walk us through one you built: how it was designed, what broke and how you fixed it

  • Production experience with at least one agent or LLM framework, such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex or AutoGen, and a solid understanding of AI architectures like RAG, reranking and multi-agent orchestration. Experience with LangGraph specifically is a plus

  • A security-first mindset: you think about data access, permissions and failure modes in everything you build, especially when agents can take real actions

  • Strong product sense and communication skills, with the ability to work directly with non-technical teams to understand their workflows and turn them into reliable automation

  • Comfort with ambiguity and an ownership mentality: you can take a loosely defined problem from idea to production on your own

  • Nice to have: experience running AWS workloads in production and knowing how to design for, deploy on and get the most out of Amazon's services, ideally including Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

jobs.jobDescription:
ICON Prime is seeking an entrepreneurial, high-impact Associate Business Development Director to expand our defense business across the military services, from military construction (MILCON) to defense technology (MilTech). You will operate with significant autonomy to generate, shape, and close complex government opportunities. The ideal candidate has a defense background, a proven track record of winning competitive government contracts and converting relationships into awards, and knows how to navigate the Pentagon and defense innovation pathways to align ICON's capabilities with the government's highest-priority requirements. You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, and Regulatory teams so that BD commitments are technically grounded and contractually executable and customer needs shape our product roadmap. This role is based in Washington, DC, reports to the Senior Director, Prime Business Development & Government Affairs, and requires up to 30% travel.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and execute a business development strategy to expand ICON Prime's presence across DoD, including the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, and National Guard.

  • Build and maintain a high-quality federal pipeline. Engage program offices, requirements owners, and contracting officers early to shape opportunities before they are released.

  • Cultivate deep relationships with key stakeholders at USACE, NAVFAC, AFCEC, DIU, AFWERX, and service-specific construction and installation commands.

  • Lead capture for targeted opportunities end to end, from business validation and qualification through gate reviews, proposal development, final proposal revisions, and contract negotiation, including teaming strategy and pricing guidance.

  • Pursue design-build, OTA, and IDIQ opportunities, including barracks, hardened facilities, and base infrastructure, as well as expeditionary construction and SCIF deployment.

  • Develop and deliver briefings, white papers, and capability narratives for general officers and senior civilian officials, and represent ICON at industry events, industry days, and installation visits.

  • Conduct market intelligence and competitive analysis, and assess competitors and emerging trends to guide capture strategy and product roadmap decisions.

  • Partner with Engineering, Operations, and Regulatory teams to ensure solutions align with Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC) and service requirements, and bring customer feedback into product development and the product roadmap.

  • Maintain pipeline and customer data in HubSpot, contribute to pipeline and gate reviews with Prime leadership, and support and manage business development and proposal professionals as the team grows.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of business development, capture management, or program management experience within DoD or military construction, with a track record of closing competitive federal contracts.

  • Experience working with federal government agencies, DoW organizations, or military construction projects with understanding of government contracting and acquisition processes.

  • Deep fluency in federal procurement, including FAR/DFARS, OTAs, IDIQs, DIU and AFWERX pathways, SBIR/STTR, the MILCON process, and defense appropriations cycles.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to present complex technical information to government stakeholders, military officials, and internal teams, and create compelling proposals, presentations, and technical marketing content.

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking abilities with demonstrated success establishing trust and credibility with government agencies and federal stakeholders in professional and regulatory environments.

  • Proven ability to engage senior DoD stakeholders at the Pentagon, service command, or major command level.

  • Working knowledge of Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC) and military design standards.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to self-direct and execute at startup speed with limited institutional support.

  • Ability to travel up to 30% for customer meetings, conferences, and industry events.

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.


PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Prior military or federal civilian service, particularly with USACE, NAVFAC, AFCEC, Marine Corps Installations Command, or a DoD R&D command, including Navy Civil Engineer Corps or Seabees, Air Force civil engineering, or Marine Corps engineering and facilities.

  • Active or current eligibility for a Secret or TS/SCI security clearance (TS/SCI preferred).

  • Familiarity with MILCON project delivery, OTA construction agreements, or other non-traditional defense acquisition pathways.

  • Background in design-build or fast-track delivery, or in 3D printing, additive manufacturing, robotics in construction, or other innovative construction methods.

  • Graduate degree in construction management, engineering, or a related discipline, or a background in management consulting or strategic advisory focused on defense.

ICON is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an innovative, inclusive, diverse and discrimination-free work environment. It is our policy to administer all personnel actions, including recruiting, hiring, training, and promoting employees, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected classification in accordance with applicable federal and state laws. Consistent with the obligations of these laws, ICON will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Furthermore, as a federal government contractor, the Company maintains an affirmative action program which furthers its commitment and complies with recordkeeping and reporting requirements under certain federal civil rights laws and regulations, including Executive Order 11246, Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 (as amended) and the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974 (as amended).

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Labs is looking for an Majors Account Executive, Key Customers who will be responsible for prospecting and growing existing business across the West region. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with existing customers. You will manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking about our products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Customer Success team.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Identify new opportunities to expand Grafana usage within 3-5 top existing accounts across multiple functions and business lines.

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships at Executive level in current customers

  • Create and execute strategic plans for defined account set

  • Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals

  • Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, negotiations and account management)

  • Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads

  • Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise

  • Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce

  • Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 8+ Years of Experience in Infrastructure Technology Sales

  • Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)

  • Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player

  • Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies

  • You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience using Salesforce

  • Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage

  • Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal

Compensation & Rewards:

In the USA, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is 360,000-380,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

jobs.jobDescription:
[Quora is a privately held, "remote-first" company. This position can be performed remotely from anywhere in Canada or the United States. Please visit careers.quora.com/eligible-countries for details regarding employment eligibility by country.]

About Quora:

Quora’s mission is to grow the world's collective intelligence. To do so, we have two platforms:

  • Quora: a global knowledge sharing platform with millions of monthly unique visitors, bringing people together to share insights on various topics and providing a unique platform to learn and connect with others.

  • Poe: a cloud workspace where millions of users run multiple AI agents on shared context and tools. One subscription, every frontier model, and the collaboration layer that makes them work together.

Behind these products are passionate, collaborative, and high-performing global teams. We have a culture rooted in transparency, idea-sharing, and experimentation that allows us to celebrate success and grow together through meaningful work. Join us on this journey to create a positive impact and make a significant change in the world.

This role will be supporting both our Quora and Poe products.

About the Team and Role:

You will be a key member of the newly created Security Engineering Team, with a mission to keep Quora safe from security problems by building robust protections around our products, infrastructure and people. Our small engineering team works on challenging problems every day. We have a culture that's rooted in constantly learning and improving, and our engineers are encouraged to think big and experiment with new ideas.

What We're Looking For:

  • Sweat The Right Details: you thrive in understanding the details but will also know to ruthlessly prioritize the critical issues.

  • Right-Size The Solution: you recognize guidelines and framework do not always fit the problem and know how to adjust the solution for scalability not always at-scale.

  • Ownership: you are outcome focused and can deftly navigate obstacles, decompose complexities, manage your time and can communicate your vision to peers and management.

An Ideal Candidate Would...

be a capable software engineer while also spiking in at least one of the following domain expertise:

  • Cloud Infrastructure Security: You have hands-on experience securing large-scale cloud environments, particularly with AWS. You are passionate about building secure infrastructure-as-code (IaC) pipelines using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation. You understand IAM policies, network segmentation, and VPC design and have a thorough grasp of monitoring and logging in cloud-native environments. You are skilled in identifying misconfigurations, mitigating risks, and driving remediation processes. Bonus points if you've implemented security in Kubernetes clusters or serverless architectures.

  • Automation and Secure Development Practices: You believe in "security as code" and are skilled at automating security processes. You can develop and integrate security tools into CI/CD pipelines to ensure secure code delivery. Tools like SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning are part of your daily toolkit, and you have experience integrating them into workflows to catch vulnerabilities early. You also advocate for secure coding practices and are skilled at mentoring teams to write resilient, secure applications.

  • Linux/System Security: You are well versed in AWS infrastructure security but also are passionate about scalability, reliability and operational rigor. Beyond that, you know that root does not mean root and are passionate about container security, POSIX Capabilities, SECCOMP and have a favorite flavor of LSM. In your spare time, you love playing around with OSQuery and eBPF.

  • Product Security (nice-to-have): Not a requirement, but a real plus: experience building secure web applications and APIs, with a working grasp of the OWASP Top 10 and common vulnerabilities such as XSS, CSRF, and SQL injection. It complements the infrastructure security focus of this role and helps when partnering with product teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with engineering teams to review cloud and compute architecture design changes

  • Establish threat models for cloud and compute paved roads to identify security risks

  • Develop or adopt open-source tools to monitor and harden our cloud Infrastructure, harden our OS, develop security logging pipelines and detect intrusions

  • Apply your expert knowledge of security best practices for AWS and Kubernetes to inform remediations and the team's control roadmap

  • Drive the definition and implementation of security policies and monitor in conformance to the policies

  • Write code for automations that support security requirements like threat detection, incident containment, and network access management.

  • Conduct initial incident triage; determine scope, urgency, and potential impact of security incidents; participate in the incident response process

At Quora, we value diversity and inclusivity and welcome individuals from all backgrounds, including marginalized or underrepresented groups in tech, to apply for our job openings. We encourage all candidates who share a passion for growing the world’s knowledge, even those who may not strictly meet all the preferred requirements, to apply, as we know that a diverse range of perspectives can have a significant impact on our products and our culture.

Additional Information:

Successful candidates must have availability for meetings and impromptu communication during Quora's “coordination hours" (Mon-Fri: 9am-3pm Pacific Time).

We are accepting applications on an ongoing basis.

Quora offers a wide range of benefits including medical/dental/vision coverage, equity refreshers, remote work reimbursement, paid time off, employee assistance programs, and more. Benefits are country-specific and may vary.

There are many factors that will determine the starting compensation, including but not limited to experience, location, education, and business needs.

  • US candidates only: For US based applicants, the salary range is $172,279 - $249,640 USD + equity + benefits.

  • Canada candidates only: For Toronto and Vancouver based applicants, the salary range is $221,209 - $256,433 CAD + equity + benefits. For all other locations in Canada, the salary range is $206,461 - $239,337 CAD + equity + benefits.

  • In equity-eligible countries, we currently also offer a flexible equity program where a portion of equity compensation may be taken as cash.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

AI technology may assist in sorting applications and recording interview notes, but all decisions are made by a member of our team.

To ensure a secure hiring process, all final candidates will undergo identity verification and a comprehensive background check prior to onboarding.

jobs.jobExcerpt: Who we are Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond. Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building…
jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

Your Impact

Help Scout has earned something most software companies never get: genuine trust. 10,000+ businesses use us because we've always believed that customer relationships are the business, and that every interaction should feel like it came from someone who cares. That trust took a decade to build, and now it's the foundation for something bigger.

A lot of that trust is design. When customers tell us why they picked Help Scout over the alternatives, and when they recommend us to someone else, the reason they give most often is that it is easier to use and it feels better to work in. That's why our top source for new customers comes from human and agent referrals. Our user experience is one of the strongest advantages we have, and as Director of Product Design you'll be directly accountable for keeping our quality high as we accelerate our growth.

About the role

  • Lead our product design team as a player/coach. Manage and develop a small team of experienced product designers and stay close to the work through critique, design reviews, and occasional projects of your own. Your most senior individual contributors carry the most complex design problems; your job is to make sure the whole team's work meets the bar. Set clear expectations for craft and ownership and build a culture where critique and feedback make the work better.

  • Turn great design judgment into something that scales. Own the design principles, standards, guardrails, and decision record that make a Help Scout experience feel like Help Scout, so designers, engineers, and AI agents can create high-quality experiences with more speed and autonomy. Your most senior designers author the interaction models and product patterns that sit underneath them.

  • Be accountable for our design system as a product. Set the priorities and resourcing for the Help Scout Design System (HSDS), drive its adoption across Product and Engineering, and make it useful and legible to both people and machines, working with the designer who serves as its technical lead for architecture, patterns, and Figma/code parity.

  • Own how AI shows up in our product. AI is every designer's job, not one person's. You are accountable for Help Scout's point of view on trustworthy AI experiences: how AI communicates, gives people control, handles mistakes, and moves from assisting customers to acting on their behalf. Your most senior designers lead the design direction and patterns; you make sure that point of view is adopted and applied consistently by every designer, and that it evolves with the product.

  • Evolve how design gets done as AI accelerates delivery. Own the operating model: workflows, tooling standards, design debt, how design works with Product and Engineering, and how the capacity AI frees up gets reinvested. Decide which of the practices the team pilots (code prototyping, AI-assisted workflows) become the standard way we work. Your most senior designers shape how AI fits into the design process itself; you make sure that guidance becomes how the team actually works.

  • Help shape product direction alongside Product and Engineering. As a member of our Experience Leadership Team (XLT), bring design judgment, customer understanding, and a clear view of where design investment will have the greatest roadmap impact. Carry business context, constraints, and initiative outcomes back to the design team, and bring designers into the forums where direction for their work is being set.

  • Decide where design capacity goes. Match designers to workstreams based on business priority. Decide who is embedded where, when someone shifts to a higher-priority problem, and when designers move from horizontal work to a deep, time-bound embed in a single workstream.

  • Partner with the Brand Design team in our GTM organization to help ensure design cohesion between marketing and in-app product experiences.

About you

  • You're an experienced product design leader who still loves the work. You bring 10+ years in product design, including 3+ years managing designers, and have been accountable for the experience of a product, as well as the people creating it.

  • You have exceptional product and design judgment. You care about craft in a way that shows up in the details, can clearly articulate why an experience works, and have experience making complex B2B software feel simple and intuitive.

  • You know how to scale great product design. You've built or meaningfully evolved a design system that teams genuinely adopted, and you know how to translate taste and judgment into principles, patterns, and systems others can apply.

  • You have a strong point of view on AI and the future of product design. You use AI throughout your own design practice and think deeply about both how AI changes the way products are designed and how to create AI experiences customers can trust.

  • You know how to lead senior individual contributors. You've managed principal or staff-level designers, given them real scope, and made them more effective without competing with them for the work.

  • You're a deeply cross-functional product leader. You're technically fluent enough to earn the trust of engineers, comfortable using data and customer research to inform your decisions, and skilled at partnering with Product and Engineering on difficult tradeoffs.

  • You're an exceptional communicator and remote leader. You make your thinking visible through clear writing and direct feedback, treat words as part of the product experience, and know how to build trust, alignment, and a strong design culture on a distributed team.

Who you'll work with

  • Chief Product Officer. You report to the CPO and partner closely with them.

  • Chief Revenue Officer. You partner on design cohesion between marketing and product, and on how design shows up in GTM.

  • VP of Engineering. You collaborate on how design and engineering work together, on the design system, and on AI-assisted delivery.

  • Principal Designer. Our most senior individual contributor reports to you and leads product design direction across workstreams, the design direction for AI experiences, and the technical shape of HSDS.

  • Product Designers. A small team of experienced designers embedded in our product workstreams.

Note: This role is open to US-based applicants only.

Company values

Happy to Help

Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.

Craft over Convention

Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.

Progress not Perfection

Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.

Own the Outcome

Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.

Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here.

Benefits And Perks

  • Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data

  • Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you

  • 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care

  • A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

  • A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house

  • A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft

  • If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents.

Hiring Guidelines:

All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements.

We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it's the right thing to do.

To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them.

A note on the use of AI in our interview process

While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we'd like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.

On our end, we utilize a platform called Brighthire as a notetaker and review tool to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process.

Beware of scammers! All legitimate communication from Help Scout regarding your application will come directly from an @helpscout.com email address and through our applicant tracking system, Ashby. We will never ask for personal financial information or conduct interviews outside of these official channels.

jobs.jobDescription:
Instrument is a design and technology company. We build brands, products, and experiences that move businesses forward—by making the complex simple.

For over 20 years, we’ve partnered with companies like Google, ServiceNow, Uber, Eventbrite, and ŌURA, helping them navigate change, launch new ideas, and grow with intention.

Our work spans Brand, Marketing, and Product, but what defines us is how we work. We bring strategy, design, and engineering together from the start, moving quickly from idea to execution and refining as we go. We aim to do great work and be great to work with, because both matter.

We’re a collaborative, hands-on team with roots in Portland and New York and a distributed presence across the U.S. and Europe. We build teams around the needs of the work, staying nimble without sacrificing craft.

We value curiosity, perspective, and continuous learning, and we’re committed to building an inclusive environment where people can do their best work.

If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.

The Role

Instrument is looking for a Strategy Director to provide senior strategic leadership across a complex portfolio of digital, brand, and marketing work for a leading technology client.

This is a highly client-facing role for someone who can quickly build trust, bring clarity to ambiguity, and connect product, customer, brand, and business thinking. You’ll oversee multiple workstreams, guide cross-disciplinary teams, and help shape both the work in progress and future opportunities.

Contract role, 40 hours per week. Needed ASAP through December 23, with a high likelihood of extension

West Coast-based required. Travel to Seattle required approximately 1–2 times per month

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the senior strategy lead across a varied portfolio spanning digital product, brand, marketing, and experience work.

  • Be a trusted, confident day-to-day partner to senior client stakeholders—leading conversations, framing decisions, and bringing thoughtful points of view.

  • Bring strong UX and product strategy rigor to complex business and customer challenges, translating insight into clear direction for design, creative, and delivery teams.

  • Guide strategic work from discovery and definition through recommendations, delivery, and iteration.

  • Partner closely with design, creative, technology, production, and account teams to ensure strategic coherence across workstreams.

  • Develop clear narratives, presentations, and decision frameworks that make complex ideas actionable and compelling.

  • Support proposal development and growth opportunities across the broader technology and commerce portfolio.

  • Help teams navigate fast-moving priorities while maintaining a high bar for strategic quality and client partnership.

What You'll Bring

  • Significant experience leading strategy for complex, high-visibility client relationships.

  • A robust UX and product strategy foundation, with the ability to move comfortably between product experiences and brand or marketing work.

  • Strong SaaS and/or B2B experience; experience with enterprise platforms, connected ecosystems, or technical products is especially valuable.

  • Exceptional client presence and facilitation skills, with a demonstrated ability to build credibility quickly with senior stakeholders.

  • A systems thinker who can oversee multiple workstreams without losing sight of the customer, the business, or the quality of the work.

  • A clear, compelling communicator—equally comfortable shaping a strategic narrative, leading a working session, or presenting recommendations.

  • Experience partnering across disciplines and helping teams turn ambiguity into aligned action.

  • Experience supporting proposals, pitches, or account-growth conversations.

  • Curiosity about emerging technology and AI, paired with sound judgment about how they should inform the work.

What We Offer

The expected pay range for this position is $113-$140/hr. Contract compensation is determined by location, experience, and skillset. We have three regional pay ranges that are adjusted for cost of living (US1 +15%, US2 +7.5%, US3 Base), *learn more about our pay philosophy and cost of living adjustments.

Benefits may be available in accordance with applicable law and company policy, including eligibility based on hours worked and duration of assignment.

Compensation

Additional Information

What We Offer

Flexible, Hybrid Work Environment

Great Compensation with Annual Reviews (Learn more about our Pay Philosophy)

401(k) Matching with Immediate Vesting

Robust Medical, Vision, and Accident Insurance

Generous Paid Holidays and unlimited PTO

Monthly Wellbeing Stipend

Career Management and Leadership Training

jobs.jobExcerpt: JOB SUMMARY: Natera is seeking a Data Privacy Director to help advance and operationalize the enterprise privacy program across our commercial, clinical, and product environments. This is a broad, hands-on leadership role supporting the full range of the Privacy team's work — from privacy impact assessments and regulatory analysis to contract and legal privacy-focused reviews…
jobs.jobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Natera is seeking a Data Privacy Director to help advance and operationalize the enterprise privacy program across our commercial, clinical, and product environments. This is a broad, hands-on leadership role supporting the full range of the Privacy team's work — from privacy impact assessments and regulatory analysis to contract and legal privacy-focused reviews — with a strong business-enablement orientation. This role reports to the Vice President, Data Privacy and partners with cross-functional teams to embed privacy principles throughout the lifecycle of data, technology, and innovation initiatives. The Director may also provide guidance and mentorship to privacy team members and external resources supporting the program.

The Director will also serve as a key integration point between Privacy and Product, embedding privacy-by-design into product and software development lifecycles and partnering with engineering to make privacy practical and scalable. In partnership with Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, and Data Sciences (R&D), this leader will also enhance and maintain data governance frameworks that support clinical research initiatives and the responsible use of data for quality improvement and development activities. Together, these efforts will help strengthen Natera’s privacy program, building efficient, repeatable processes that expand team capacity while enabling responsible innovation and growth.

Regarding culture, we seek people who demonstrate Natera's values, enjoy challenging problems, empower others to thrive, lead by example, and adapt their playbook when necessary.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Privacy Program Enablement

  • Lead privacy impact assessments, regulatory analyses, and risk-based recommendations that balance compliance with business enablement

  • Conduct privacy reviews of contracts and legal engagements, drafting recommendations for counsel review, alignment, and approval

  • Apply a risk-based lens to enable business decisions

  • Build efficient, repeatable processes and tooling that scale program capacity within a resource-constrained team

  • Provide direction and mentorship to team members and external resources as the program scales

Privacy Integration & Engineering

  • Serve as the integration point between Privacy and Product/Engineering, embedding privacy-by-design into product and software development lifecycles

  • Partner with technical teams to translate privacy requirements into practical controls, patterns, and reusable technical solutions

  • Support privacy engineering practices that operationalize compliance without slowing delivery

Data Use Governance & Decision Frameworks

  • Implement standardized, risk-based frameworks for data access, sharing, secondary use, and commercial/partnership data usage

  • Drive consistency in how data use decisions are evaluated, approved, and documented across the organization

Data Ethics & Responsible Data Use

  • Operationalize guardrails for use of sensitive and regulated data, AI/ML training data, and advanced analytics

  • Embed ethical considerations into governance processes and decision-making

Commercial & Clinical Data Ecosystem Governance

  • Govern data flows and usage across marketing/advertising technologies, commercial partnerships, and third-party data sharing

  • Serve as the embedded privacy partner for Medical Affairs and Clinical Operations, advising on privacy requirements for clinical research protocols, clinical trials, real-world evidence studies, and secondary use of clinical data

  • Collaborate with Clinical Operations to ensure data flows and consent frameworks align with applicable regulations (HIPAA, IRB requirements, GCP guidelines) and internal governance standards

  • Support privacy for clinical research, clinical trials, and secondary research use of data

  • Enable business teams to leverage data responsibly while minimizing regulatory and reputational risk

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (e.g., law/legal studies, information systems, business administration, data analytics); IAPP certification highly preferred (e.g., CIPP, CIPT, AGCP)

  • 8-10 years of experience in privacy, data governance, compliance, or related disciplines, with increasing leadership responsibility

  • Strong expertise in global privacy regulations (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, etc.)

  • Experience embedding privacy into product and software development lifecycles (privacy-by-design, privacy engineering)

  • Experience supporting clinical research or clinical trials from a privacy perspective, including working directly with Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, or similar teams

  • Familiarity with IRB processes, informed consent frameworks, and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) as they relate to data privacy

  • General healthcare compliance background (e.g., fraud, waste & abuse, Stark Law, Anti-Kickback Statute, Sunshine Act)

  • Experience working across commercial, clinical, and product/technology environments

  • Familiarity with AI/ML and advanced analytics governance concepts as they relate to data use and ethics

  • Proven ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical, scalable processes

  • Strong ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across functions

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or managing privacy professionals or cross-functional teams

  • Experience with program management and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, Google Workspace)

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • A systems thinker who connects fragmented processes into cohesive, scalable solutions

  • A bridge-builder across technical, legal, and business domains— including Medical Affairs and Clinical Operations

  • Effective in complex environments and able to build structure and alignment across stakeholder groups

  • Passionate about responsible data use and enabling growth through pragmatic privacy

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$170,000—$240,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

jobs.jobDescription:
Introduction to Demandbase:

Demandbase is the only pipeline AI platform that empowers GTM teams to automate growth at scale. With a unified view of data, insights, actions, and outcomes, B2B enterprises can seamlessly align and execute their account-based GTM strategies with confidence. Thousands of businesses trust Demandbase to maximize revenue, minimize waste, and consolidate their data and tech stacks – all in one platform.

As a company, we’re as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class technology. We invest heavily in people, our culture, and the community around us. We have also continuously been recognized as One of The Best Places To Work in the San Francisco Bay Area by Fortune, and One of The 60 Best Companies To Sell For by Selling Power. Our offices are located in San Francisco, New York, Austin, Seattle, India, and the United Kingdom.

The Role

Demandbase is accelerating its Agentic Marketing roadmap to bring customers an AI-native platform that performs critical B2B marketing jobs on behalf of marketers. We are looking for a senior product manager to ensure those capabilities do not merely ship; they become trusted, habitual, and monetizable parts of how marketing teams work.

This role will own the customer journey from initial discovery and first value through repeat AI usage, cross-capability adoption, consumption growth, and commercial expansion.

Strategic Responsibilities

  • Define the product-led growth strategy for Demandbase’s AI-native application

  • Own the end-to-end adoption funnel across discovery, activation, repeat use, capability composition, AI consumption, and expansion

  • Identify the behaviors that represent meaningful customer value, not merely clicks, sessions, or feature exposure

  • Partner with application PMs to remove friction and introduce the next relevant job or capability at the right moment

  • Design and run product experiments involving onboarding, recommendations, defaults, templates, notifications, approvals, usage visibility, and upgrade paths

  • Develop lifecycle strategies for new customers and existing customers across multiple GTM user personas

  • Partner with Product Analytics and Data Science to establish instrumentation, behavioral cohorts, experimentation methods, and leading indicators of retention and expansion

  • Partner with Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing on AI packaging, credit models, trials, entitlements, and expansion motions

  • Create reusable growth patterns and platform requirements that can be applied across composable capabilities

  • Turn successful experiments into durable product experiences and operating practices

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ Years in Product Management or related field with experience in SaaS growth, PLG, AI products, or workflow platforms

  • Demonstrated ability to move activation, retention, expansion, or consumption metrics through shipped product changes

  • Comfortable working across onboarding, core workflows, lifecycle engagement, packaging, and monetization

  • Strong analytical and experimental judgment; able to distinguish correlation from evidence sufficient for a product decision

  • Experience influencing multiple product teams without taking over their roadmaps

  • Able to connect customer behavior, qualitative research, product strategy, and commercial outcomes

  • Familiarity with enterprise buying and adoption dynamics; understand that enterprise PLG includes admins, champions, permissions, enablement, and sales-assisted expansion

  • AI product experience is strongly preferred

Key Success Metrics

  • Establish a shared AI adoption and monetization funnel

  • Define activation for each priority JTBD and for the composed product experience

  • Reduce time to first meaningful AI outcome

  • Increase the percentage of active users and tenants completing high-value AI jobs

  • Increase repeat AI use and the number of customers using multiple complementary capabilities

  • Identify which behaviors predict retention, expansion, and increased AI consumption

  • Launch and evaluate experiments that materially improve adoption

  • Help define the product mechanics required for trials, entitlements, credit visibility, and usage-based expansion

Why This Role?

This is the ideal role for a high-agency, analytically minded PM who loves turning customer behavior into product decisions and experiments. You won’t just ship AI features; you’ll ensure customers discover them, reach value quickly, build habits around them, and expand into the broader composable platform. You will have the unique opportunity to build the growth engine that turns Demandbase’s AI-native vision into sustained adoption, consumption, retention, and revenue.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Demandbase

At Demandbase, we believe in creating a workplace culture that values and celebrates diversity in all its forms. We recognize that everyone brings unique experiences, perspectives, and identities to the table, and we are committed to building a community where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. Discrimination of any kind is not tolerated, and we strive to ensure that every individual has an equal opportunity to succeed and grow, regardless of their gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, race, ethnicity, background, marital status, genetic information, education level, veteran status, national origin, or any other protected status. We do not automatically disqualify applicants with criminal records and will consider each applicant on a case-by-case basis.

We recognize that not all candidates will have every skill or qualification listed in this job description. If you feel you have the level of experience to be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply!

We acknowledge that true diversity and inclusion requires ongoing effort, and we are committed to doing the work required to make our workplace a safe and equitable space for all. Join us in building a community where we can learn from each other, celebrate our differences, and work together.

Unsolicited Submissions

At Demandbase, we value thoughtful partnerships and direct connections with candidates. We’re not accepting unsolicited resumes or outreach from third-party recruiting agencies. Any unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed, and no fees will be paid.
